Khazix.escape: Kha'Zix E Leap is his only mobility skill, so close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him right after he uses it to engage. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, don't chase recklessly; stay near allies and counterattack when he reappears. If Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved and he gets a takedown, its cooldown can reset, so reassess this window to engage.
Khazix.build: Build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early to prepare for the physical damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, W Void Spike, and E Leap. Armor also helps Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield absorb damage more effectively. If healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Khazix.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch immediately to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage, and don't switch to the next stance before using two empowered attacks from each stance. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken.
Khazix.fight: Avoid isolation by staying near allies or minions, and close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Kha'Zix E Leap is down. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Khazix.laning: Early on, use Udyr's fast movement between camps and sustain to gain control of the jungle and objectives. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or time your engage with an ally's crowd control. Secure vision in the river and in bushes at jungle entrances, and avoid letting Kha'Zix read your position when moving alone.
Khazix.phase: From the mid game onward, once Kha'Zix has at least two evolutions, stop acting alone and move with allies. In the late game, shift Udyr's role to holding the frontline and absorbing enemy engages.
Khazix.teamfight: Fight grouped in narrow areas where you have vision, and stay near your backline carries so they don't get isolated. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, place Udyr R Wingborne Storm along his expected entry path or stun him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when he reappears. After closing in, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and absorb Kha'Zix's engage on the frontline.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so fight near allies or minions. The moment after Kha'Zix E Leap engages is your chance to counterattack. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, don't try to reveal him with a Control Ward; wait for him to reappear and control him then.

Aatrox.phase: Aatrox gets strong quickly if he gains an early lead, so avoid giving him kills. In the late game, focus on holding the frontline and absorbing the enemy team’s engage.
Aatrox.laning: In the early game, avoid giving Aatrox kills and focus on farming. Look to trade right after Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance’s empowered attack is used on a minion. If you gank, approach through brush or from behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early to prepare for the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield becomes more effective with armor. If Aatrox’s healing turns long duels around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item.
Aatrox.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Next, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Aatrox’s damage lands, and stick to the basic rotation of using two empowered attacks each time you switch stances.
Aatrox.escape: Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede immediately after forcing Aatrox to use E Umbral Dash. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, keep a mobility option available so you can escape before being pulled back.
Aatrox.fight: Look for a fight right after Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance’s empowered attack is used on a minion or Aatrox E Umbral Dash goes down. Avoid the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as you close in, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. Disengage during Aatrox R World Ender and engage again after it expires.
Aatrox.teamfight: If you can get through Aatrox’s crowd control, engage by awakening Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment. If engaging is difficult, stay beside the frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you’re in, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path.
Aatrox.watch: When Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is telegraphed, step outside the blade’s edge or move in close to avoid the knock-up and heavy damage. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing is stronger, so create distance and wait out its duration.

Akali.build: Prioritize magic resistance for your first defensive purchase. Armor does not help against Akali’s main damage, and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield prevents more actual damage as your magic resistance increases. Build health afterward so you don’t easily enter Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Get a shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Akali’s heavy damage lands. If Akali disappears into Akali W Twilight Shroud, don’t chase recklessly; wait for a chance to attack again.
Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. An opening to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede comes when Akali E Shuriken Flip is also down or before Akali R Perfect Execution is back up. If the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike is stopping your engage, you can break through with the awakened version of Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Akali.laning: If you walk straight in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, Akali can escape with her mobility. Look for an opening when she steps forward or an ally catches her first.
Akali.phase: In the early and mid game, use Udyr’s fast camp clears and movement speed to secure control of the jungle and objectives. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on the frontline role.
Akali.teamfight: Engage when the awakened version of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through effects that would stop your engage. If it’s difficult to get in, stay beside the frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm while absorbing the enemy’s engage. Once you’re in, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle in time for Akali’s heavy damage and use your body to block your allied carries’ path.
Akali.watch: Once the mark is applied, the second dash will follow you even if you try to run.

Aurora.fight: If Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are both available, engage once to make her use a mobility ability, then continue the fight on your next engage. Don’t drag out a fight at low health while waiting for Aurora Q Twofold Hex to be recalled.
Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Aurora’s main damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on max health, so build magic resistance and movement speed rather than stacking health alone. If Aurora’s healing is enough to turn duels around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Aurora.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand the damage. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, don’t waste abilities into empty space while chasing; wait until she reappears.
Aurora.escape: Re-engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede once both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down. If the push or pull from Aurora Q Twofold Hex is stopping your engage, break through with the awakened version of Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
Aurora.laning: Walking straight in lets Aurora escape with her mobility, so start from brush or behind terrain, or approach when an ally applies crowd control. The most reliable gank is to get behind her when she has pushed the lane. Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed to move between camps and ganks, and secure control of the jungle and objectives in the early and mid game.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so the frontline role becomes more important. The available information isn’t enough to determine when Aurora is stronger.
Aurora.teamfight: Engage if the awakened version of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through Aurora’s engage-stopping effects. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline, keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm while absorbing the enemy’s engage, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If Aurora jumps in but doesn’t secure a takedown, catch her then. When retreating, don’t leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse is recalled, and the recall damage increases with missing health. If cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora, and retreat before the recall if your health is low. After Aurora R Between Worlds forms, leaving the area slows you, so decide whether to leave before it appears or fight inside.

Kayle.teamfight: Create a path to reach Kayle directly from the flank or outside vision, and time your engage with your allies’ crowd control. Once on her, if Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, use the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to wait it out, then attack. If you can’t reach Kayle, stay beside the frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle, and peel against incoming enemy engages.
Kayle.build: Build magic resistance against Kayle’s main damage. Avoiding a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast is also important because it lowers your resistances. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is enough to turn a duel, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Kayle.escape: A good window to approach is after dodging the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and waiting for the movement speed boost from Kayle W Celestial Blessing to wear off. Kayle has no skill that lets her create distance on her own, so close in from out of vision with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun on your first basic attack.
Kayle.fight: Approach from out of vision with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun Kayle, then deal damage with empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, use the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to wait out her invulnerability, then attack again.
Kayle.laning: When ganking Kayle as Udyr, if she has pushed the lane, approach from a brush or behind terrain to get behind her.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers Udyr’s armor and magic resistance and slows him, so avoid the hit before closing in. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be careful when your health is low. Don’t pour in your damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active.
Kayle.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Just before taking a large hit, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand it.
Kayle.phase: Kayle is weak early, so use Udyr’s fast movement between camps and ganks to build a lead. In the mid game, solidify your advantage with Udyr’s jungle pressure and objective control.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close in, so move with jungle monsters between you. If Amumu has Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, avoid grouping with allies and keep your distance in open areas. After being caught, create distance again so you don’t take Amumu W Despair’s max-health damage for long.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Amumu’s magic damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is more effective with higher resistance, and stacking health alone is less effective because of Amumu W Despair. If you’re repeatedly caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, consider tenacity or a way to remove crowd control.
Amumu.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand Amumu’s damage. If you need to get through Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, decide before engaging whether to use Udyr E Blazing Stampede awakened.
Amumu.escape: Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy goes down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so stun and chase him when you get an opening to engage.
Amumu.fight: Engage when you’ve dodged Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, or when you can get through them with awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Once in, deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Amumu.laning: Start ganks from brush or behind terrain, or close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after an ally applies crowd control. Tell allies in lane to stand behind minions and move unpredictably to dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.phase: In the early and mid game, use Udyr’s control of the jungle and objectives to consolidate an advantage, but be wary of engagements once Amumu has R Curse of the Sad Mummy. In the late game, Udyr should focus more on the frontline role than dealing damage.
Amumu.teamfight: Space out from allies and fight in open areas so multiple players aren’t hit by Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Engage if awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through Amumu’s crowd control. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline, keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.

LeeSin.teamfight: Keep your back to a wall or your frontline so Lee Sin has difficulty getting behind you to use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, and leave enough space from your allies so you don’t collide with them. Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakening lets you pass through effects that stop your engage. If it’s difficult to engage, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm; once enemies close in, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
LeeSin.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. Armor also helps Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield absorb damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple.
LeeSin.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage and use two empowered attacks. After stunning, don't stay in Udyr E Blazing Stampede, and don't switch to the next stance before using two empowered attacks.
LeeSin.escape: The window before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up is your chance to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available, he can escape, so don't go deep just because one mobility skill is down. If you can read the timing of Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through its crowd control.
LeeSin.fight: If Lee Sin has just used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
LeeSin.laning: If you expect a gank, keep a minion wave between you and Lee Sin to block the direct angle of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike. Start Udyr's ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control. Alternate between camps and ganks to build an experience and vision advantage with your movement speed and sustain.
LeeSin.phase: During Udyr's peak in the early and mid game, consolidate your advantage through objective control and control of the enemy jungle. In the late game, Lee Sin falls off and Udyr also moves closer to a frontline role than a damage-dealing role, so fight with your team.
LeeSin.watch: If health has fallen below half, retreat toward an allied turret or your team while the second hit is still available. Keep your distance from walls where you have no vision, since Lee Sin can enter over them with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will.

Gwen.build: Against Gwen’s main damage, consider magic resistance items like Spectre's Cowl first, and build armor against the physical damage from her basic attacks. Gwen W Hallowed Mist increases her armor, so add penetration if Udyr’s physical damage is not getting through. If Gwen’s healing is enough to turn a duel, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Gwen.laning: Udyr can keep his health up while clearing camps and take control of the jungle and objectives in the early and mid game. When ganking Gwen, start from a brush or behind terrain, or time your approach with an ally’s crowd control. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can be used again quickly if it hits a minion, so fight where there are no minions if possible.
Gwen.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with the first attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land both empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb damage while using both empowered attacks. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken; if you need to endure longer, use Udyr W Iron Mantle Awakened.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her only mobility ability, so the moment after she uses it is a window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If the slow from Gwen R Needlework would stop your engage, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened’s crowd control immunity to counter it.
Gwen.fight: Fight before Gwen Q Snip Snip! has built stacks and just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used. Engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. Dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by moving to the side, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in.
Gwen.phase: Udyr is strong at jungle pressure and objective fights in the early to mid game, so consolidate your gains during that period. In the late game, he lacks range and area damage, so focus on the front line role.
Gwen.teamfight: Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the enemy’s engage-stopping effect. Otherwise, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb the enemy engage. Once you’re in, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle, but move to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone deals true damage, so sidestep when she casts it. Gwen R Needlework slows and deals damage based on your max health. Gwen cannot be targeted from outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist while she is inside it.

Sejuani.phase: Use the lead you built by midgame to delay Sejuani’s item timings. In the late game, Udyr should hold the frontline and absorb the enemy engage instead of chasing their damage dealers.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Sejuani’s main damage. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t stop it, and Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If you keep dying while locked down by crowd control, you can prioritize tenacity.
Sejuani.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to survive before Sejuani’s heavy damage lands. Decide which stance to use Awaken on before the fight; if you need to get through Sejuani’s crowd control, use it on Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Sejuani.escape: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, her only mobility ability, is down, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to close the gap. Create distance first if Sejuani E Permafrost’s stacks are building or you’re at an angle where you can’t dodge Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If Sejuani E Permafrost stuns you, retreat as soon as it wears off to avoid follow-up basic attacks.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani uses Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun her, then trade with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks that deal damage based on maximum health. You can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison as they come in. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, use Udyr’s fast camp rotations and health sustain to take control of the enemy jungle and objectives. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or time your approach with an ally’s crowd control. Avoid walking straight in for a gank while Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is available.
Sejuani.teamfight: Engage when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If you don’t have that opening, stay beside your frontline, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage, and hold off enemy engages. Once you’re on them, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle and body-block the enemy carries’ path.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns for longer the farther it travels, so dodge to the side when you see the windup. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before its second strike, which deals heavy damage and applies a slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from her melee allies’ basic attacks, so create distance as the indicator fills.

Belveth.build: Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal primarily physical damage, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage can’t be blocked by resistances, so withstand it with your total health. If Bel’Veth’s healing is enough to turn duels around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Belveth.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Next, use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand Bel’Veth’s damage. If you’re about to be hit by Bel’Veth W Above and Below, time the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through it.
Belveth.escape: Don’t engage just because Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down. Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below too, then close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede before her next dash. Bel’Veth can’t immediately dash again in the direction she just dashed, so move relative to that axis.
Belveth.fight: Pressure Bel’Veth’s camps and look for skirmishes early, while she has few stacks. When Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom starts, don’t unload your damage; interrupt it with a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or attack after it ends.
Belveth.laning: In the early game, steal Bel’Veth’s large monsters and camps to slow her stack growth. Start ganks from brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control. Avoid approaching head-on and giving her an angle to escape with Bel’Veth Q Void Surge.
Belveth.phase: In the mid game, use control of the jungle and objectives to consolidate your advantage. The matchup becomes less favorable over time because of Bel’Veth’s permanent stacks, and Udyr’s role also shifts toward the frontline.
Belveth.teamfight: If you can engage through Bel’Veth W Above and Below with awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede, go in; otherwise, stay beside the frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once in, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path. If an ally dies and drops a Void Coral, retreat before Bel’Veth can pick it up, and delay the team fight while Bel’Veth’s transformation is active.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel’Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces incoming damage while active, so don’t rush to use Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks.

Brand.build: Build movement speed first so you can get out of the areas Brand telegraphs, and build magic resistance for defense. Armor doesn’t help against Brand’s damage, and Brand P Blaze deals damage based on max health, so stacking health alone is less effective. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is consumed after damage has been reduced by magic resistance.
Brand.combo: Then switch to Udyr W Iron Mantle and activate its shield before taking damage.
Brand.fight: When you get in, stun him and deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Brand’s heavy damage lands to hold your ground.
Brand.laning: Don’t stand near minions Brand has set ablaze, and move to the side when the wave is clumped. For ganks, approach from brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control instead of starting head-on. If Brand has pushed the lane, get behind him and engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame goes down.
Brand.phase: At this point, take advantage of the opening when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down to close in and extend your control. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so shift to the frontline role.
Brand.teamfight: Space out from allies to avoid the spread from Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm, and don’t stand next to an ally who is ablaze. If engaging is difficult, stay beside the frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once in, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, Brand Q Sear stuns you, so when you’re ablaze, dodge the projectile or hide behind minions. Dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame also makes it easier to avoid follow-up attacks that would add Blaze stacks. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from allies to avoid the bouncing attack.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage. It’s also important to dodge Briar Q Head Rush because it reduces your resistances. If her healing turns a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Briar.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun her with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. If Briar E Chilling Scream is charging, time the first-attack stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to interrupt her healing and wall stun. Then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. If you need to hold your ground for a long time, awaken Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when both Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack are down and Briar R Certain Death is still on cooldown. If you need to get through remaining crowd control to engage, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede as that ability hits.
Briar.fight: Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when both Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack are down, or before Briar R Certain Death is back up. In a duel, land empowered attacks with Udyr Q Wilding Claw and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands.
Briar.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed to alternate between camps and ganks, securing control of the jungle in the early and mid game. Start ganks from brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control. Keep vision to prepare for Briar’s early ganks and reckless engages, and make sure allies don’t linger in the middle of a lane section without vision.
Briar.phase: In the early and mid game, use Udyr’s jungle pressure and objective fights to secure a lead. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus on the frontline role.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she runs at the nearest enemy, so Udyr should stand in front to protect the backline carries. If the frontline is hit first by the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death, it won’t target a backline carry. If awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the crowd control that would stop your engage, go in; otherwise, stay beside the frontline, keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and fight back as you absorb her engage.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes and stuns you while reducing your resistances, so watch for her engage angle and adjust your distance to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, interrupt it with the first-attack stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, and avoid fighting with your back to a wall. If Briar R Certain Death targets you, move toward your allies and fight together rather than only running away.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage and get Plated Steelcaps early. However, armor won’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on max health, so be wary of stacking health alone. If Camille’s healing is enough to turn duels around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Camille.combo: When you have an opening to get on Camille, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Camille’s heavy damage lands. If you can read when the stun from Camille E Hookshot is coming, get through it by awakening Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Camille.escape: Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Camille E Hookshot is down. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available, don’t go deep just because her E is down. Look to engage when both mobility abilities are down, especially before her R is back up.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield activates, and engage once it has been removed. Before Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second attack lands, shield yourself with Udyr W Iron Mantle or create distance. When fighting up close, make sure to land two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Camille.laning: Camille E Hookshot uses walls, so stay away from them and watch for Camille W Tactical Sweep to reach you while she’s moving on the hook. Camille is weak early before her first core item, so use Udyr’s fast camp clears and movement speed to take early control. For ganks, don’t walk in head-on; start from brush or behind terrain to get behind her when she has pushed the lane.
Camille.phase: From the mid game onward, Camille can quickly take side lane towers, so don’t leave a side lane unattended. In the late game, Udyr’s role shifts more toward the frontline than dealing damage, so absorb engages and hold your ground.
Camille.teamfight: Engage when awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the stun from Camille E Hookshot. If engaging is difficult, stay beside the frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm while absorbing Camille’s engage. Once in, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a distance and stun you, so don’t get pushed toward a wall. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered attack deals some true damage, so create distance while she prepares it.

Chogath.build: After completing your first core item, slot in Executioner's Calling if Cho'Gath P Carnivore heals enough to turn a duel around. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistances can't reduce Cho'Gath R Feast's true damage, and E Vorpal Spikes deals damage based on max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Chogath.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Switch to Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands and weather it. After changing stances, get two empowered basic attacks in, and decide which stance to awaken before engaging.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so right after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave is your chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Approach while avoiding the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. If you need to take crowd control and push through it to engage, time the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede for that moment.
Chogath.fight: When you see the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, dodge sideways, then close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him. Once you're on him, duel with the max-health-based damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. When Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is coming, you can use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to push through its crowd control and engage.
Chogath.laning: Look for an opportunity outside Cho'Gath Q Rupture's range, then pressure him right after he uses Q Rupture on the wave. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions to poke, so step out of the straight line in which his basic attacks are aimed. Push or pressure the lane early to limit Cho'Gath's chances to stack.
Chogath.phase: Consolidate your advantage in the early and mid game with jungle and objective control. Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, so the matchup gets harder over time. In the late game, when you're unsure whether your health is sufficient, avoid being killed by Cho'Gath R Feast and giving him an additional stack.
Chogath.teamfight: Engage when the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past Cho'Gath Q Rupture or W Feral Scream stopping your approach. If engaging is difficult, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to maintain area damage and slows while holding off the enemy engage. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and body-block the enemy carries' path.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you airborne after a marker appears beneath you, so move sideways as soon as you see it. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences in front of him, making the follow-up Q Rupture harder to dodge, so don't start trades from the front. If you're at half health or below, create distance to avoid Cho'Gath R Feast's true damage, which armor can't block.

Darius.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first against Darius's physical damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield becomes more effective with armor, but armor can't block the penetration from Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If Darius Q Decimate heals enough to turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks, then use Udyr W Iron Mantle to take the follow-up damage. Decide on your awakening before the fight. If you need to push through Darius E Apprehend, use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is down. If you need to engage as Darius E Apprehend comes in, time the crowd-control immunity from the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to meet it.
Darius.fight: When Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, trade briefly, then back off. Deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered basic attacks, but create distance before P Hemorrhage stacks build up. When Darius uses Q Decimate, move outside the blade or hug him closely to reduce its healing.
Darius.laning: Move around outside Darius E Apprehend's range, then trade briefly right after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. If you're looking for a gank, start from a bush or behind terrain instead of walking straight at him, or approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after an ally's crowd control. Udyr can maintain his health by changing stances and alternate between camps and ganks, so look for repeated short openings rather than a long duel.
Darius.phase: Secure your lead in the early and mid game with Udyr's jungle pressure and objective control. In the late game, Udyr's limited range and area damage mean he takes on more of a frontline role.
Darius.teamfight: Check whether you can get past Darius E Apprehend with the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede before engaging. If you can't engage, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to maintain area damage and slows while holding off the enemy engage. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle, but if P Hemorrhage stacks build up and your health gets low, move outside Darius R Noxian Guillotine's range.
Darius.watch: If you're pulled by Darius E Apprehend, Darius can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade or hug him closely to reduce its healing. If P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to break them. At low health, get completely outside Darius R Noxian Guillotine's range.

Diana.build: Build magic resistance first against Diana's main damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield blocks more actual damage as your resistance increases. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of telegraphed area attacks.
Diana.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to weather damage and make use of two empowered basic attacks. If Diana W Pale Cascade is active, wait for its orbs and shield to disappear before using this sequence.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without using Q Crescent Strike, stun her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede or slow her with Udyr R Wingborne Storm while she has no way to disengage. You can also close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after making Diana use E Lunar Rush. If you're hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, create distance in anticipation of her re-engaging.
Diana.fight: Engage after dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike or when Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark. Once Diana W Pale Cascade's orbs and shield are gone, stun her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands.
Diana.laning: Alternate Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr W Iron Mantle to maintain your health.
Diana.phase: Udyr should secure a lead in early and mid-game jungle and objective fights. In the late game, his limited range and area damage mean he should focus more on the frontline role.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out based on Diana R Moonfall's engage angle so multiple allies aren't pulled in together, and establish vision from the flanks. When the displacement comes in, use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get past it. If engaging is difficult, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge sideways instead of only moving back. If you're hit by its mark, Diana E Lunar Rush can reset, so create distance. When Diana R Moonfall pulls you in, use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get past the displacement.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Armor can't block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper. If healing is enough to turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item and maintain Grievous Wounds with Udyr's repeated basic attacks.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the first stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so use the E stun after his passive is down to engage. Use two empowered basic attacks from each stance before moving to the next.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance, so when his passive is down and you have an opening to get on him, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw prevents you from engaging, you can use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get past its crowd control. You can only awaken once per fight, so decide which stance to use before engaging.
DrMundo.fight: After Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun him, then deal max-health-based damage with two empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. If you need to last through a long duel, use W's awakening. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don't spend too long chasing him.
DrMundo.laning: Use Udyr's fast movement between camps and health sustain to alternate between ganks and camps and take control in the early and mid game. Start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or look for an angle where an ally can apply crowd control first so you can close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Step on Dr. Mundo's dropped canister as you retreat after a fight to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Start a fight or contest an objective while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down. If R is available, look for advantages elsewhere instead of chasing Mundo for too long. In the late game, Udyr should focus on the frontline role rather than dealing damage.
DrMundo.teamfight: Engage when the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past the enemy's engage-stopping effects. If engaging is difficult, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm while holding off the enemy engage. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and body-block the enemy carries' path.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it reaches and deals more damage the higher your current health is, so dodge with minions between you and him. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don't rely on the first stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to engage.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance against Ekko's magic damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield blocks more actual damage as your resistance increases. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak would turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Ekko.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb damage. If you need to get through the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko E Phase Dive is down is a good window to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him. However, he can escape if Ekko R Chronobreak is available, so look for a full fight before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up. Engage while avoiding the area where you saw the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence.
Ekko.fight: Stun Ekko with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. You can pressure him to use Ekko R Chronobreak while his mobility is down. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Ekko's heavy damage lands.
Ekko.laning: Alternate Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr W Iron Mantle to maintain your health as you move between camps and ganks. Start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control. Ekko can escape with Ekko E Phase Dive if you approach head-on, so get behind him when he pushes the lane.
Ekko.phase: Start a fight while Ekko R Chronobreak is down to secure your lead. In the late game, Udyr should focus more on the frontline role than dealing damage.
Ekko.teamfight: Stun Ekko with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive to pressure him to use Ekko R Chronobreak. Engage if the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past the enemy's engage-stopping crowd control. If it can't, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries' path.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid both the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder's return hit hurts more, so move out of its return path. If you see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't chase recklessly even if his health looks low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce damage from Elise's main abilities. Also consider armor and tenacity because she deals damage with basic attacks too. If Elise's healing would turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Elise.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to weather damage. Get two empowered basic attacks from each stance before switching.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Q Venomous Bite is a chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, turn on her. While she is using E Rappel, wait for her to land before attacking.
Elise.fight: Dodge Elise E Cocoon or get past it with the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then approach. Once you're on her, deal damage with two empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands.
Elise.laning: Watch for Elise's ganks early and ward generously. Don't push the lane recklessly while Elise is missing. Udyr should alternate between camps and lane ganks, and attempt ganks when he can start from a bush or behind terrain, or close in after an ally's crowd control.
Elise.phase: It's important not to give up kills to Elise's ganks early. In the late game, shift to the frontline role and hold off enemies who close in.
Elise.teamfight: Engage if you can use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get past Elise E Cocoon as it comes in. If you can't engage, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm while holding off the enemy engage. Once you're on them, weather damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries' path.
Elise.watch: Be especially careful of Elise Q Neurotoxin when health is full, and of Elise Q Venomous Bite after health has decreased and Elise has transformed into spider form.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn's main damage. Evelynn W Allure reduces your magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If the healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade would turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Evelynn.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to weather damage, and get two empowered basic attacks each time you change stances. If you know when the charm from Evelynn W Allure will land, time the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede for that moment.
Evelynn.escape: Don't engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. The chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is when both Evelynn E Whiplash and Evelynn R Last Caress are down, before R comes back up. Back off before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures and charms you. If you know when the charm will land, use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get past its crowd control.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and look for an opening to fight after dodging the charm. If you can get on her, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun her and deal damage with empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Evelynn's heavy damage lands.
Evelynn.laning: Place a regular ward beside the jungle camps where Evelynn starts fighting, and use a Control Ward to cover her gank routes. Start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control.
Evelynn.phase: Secure a lead with objective and enemy-jungle control while Udyr is strong in the early and mid game. In the late game, shift Udyr toward the frontline role to protect your allies.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline carries, so wait for her engage in an area where your team has vision and save Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun. If the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can't get you past the enemy's engage-stopping effects, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back off before the charm lands and alert your allies. At low health, watch out for the execute damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and don't stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks's damage. If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest heals enough to turn a duel around, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to weather damage and make use of two empowered basic attacks. If you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, save Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun until then.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down, you can engage without worrying about being hit by that crowd control.
Fiddlesticks.fight: If you know when Fiddlesticks Q Terrify will land, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede to push through its crowd control and approach.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to move quickly between camps and lanes, and suspect a bush ambush if Fiddlesticks hasn't been seen for a while. Set up ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or find an angle to get on the target after an ally applies crowd control. Establish vision in the bushes and entrances near objectives, and don't pass beside an unchecked Scarecrow Effigy.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, shift Udyr toward the frontline role and watch out for Fiddlesticks's area engage.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm can come from a bush, so don't bunch up in narrow paths without vision. If you see him channeling, interrupt him with the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If it's already active, leave the area. Engage when the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past the crowd control that stops your approach. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm with the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede when you see him channeling. If you can't interrupt it, leave the area. When Fiddlesticks is missing, watch out for Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm coming from a bush. Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest heals for a lot if fully channeled too, so look for a chance to interrupt it with a stun.

Fiora.build: Prioritize Plated Steelcaps and armor against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge. If healing is making the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Fiora.combo: Bait out Fiora W Riposte first, then close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede while Fiora Q Lunge is down. Stun her with the first E attack, switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land both empowered attacks, then follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use both empowered attacks before switching to the next stance.
Fiora.escape: The moment after Fiora Q Lunge is an opportunity to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Fiora W Riposte is still available, it can block E’s stun, so wait until Riposte is down before landing the first attack. If you can read when Riposte’s stun is coming, use the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede to ignore the crowd control.
Fiora.fight: Bait out Fiora Q Lunge, then close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Confirm Fiora W Riposte is down, stun her with the first E attack, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. Stand opposite the vital on your body to narrow her approach angle. Trade briefly, then don’t chase recklessly.
Fiora.laning: Look to counterattack when Fiora dives toward a vital. If you approach head-on, she can escape with Fiora Q Lunge, so enter from a brush or behind terrain when she pushes the lane. You can also wait for an ally to apply crowd control and create an angle to engage.
Fiora.phase: Catch Fiora with two or more people or force a team fight.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall to block one side of the vitals. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the enemy’s engage-stopping effects. Otherwise, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb the enemy engage with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects. If it blocks Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun, it stuns Udyr instead. While Riposte is available, don’t rush the first E attack; move to the side when she casts it to avoid the parry. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall so she can’t hit all four vitals.

Gangplank.build: If Gangplank Q Parrrley harass is heavy, get Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor. More armor increases the effective survivability from Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield. Resistance doesn’t help against the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage, so get health too. If healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Gangplank.combo: If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land both empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before Gangplank’s heavy damage comes in.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg or a keg is destroyed. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is also down, he can’t remove Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. If you need to push through a keg’s slow, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede as the effect reaches you.
Gangplank.fight: Right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and trade. Back off if an aged keg is nearby, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in. In a one-on-one, deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Gangplank.laning: Rotate Udyr Q Wilding Claw and W Iron Mantle to maintain health while clearing camps. If Gangplank pushes the lane, approach from a brush or behind terrain and get behind him.
Gangplank.phase: Udyr is strong at clearing camps and dueling early, and his jungle pressure and objective fighting peak in the early to mid game. Udyr takes on more of a front line role later, so secure your lead through enemy-jungle and objective control in the early to mid game.
Gangplank.teamfight: Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the enemy’s engage-stopping effect. If there’s no opening, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb the enemy engage. Once you’re in, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carry’s path with your body.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes dangerous as it ages, so avoid aged kegs and spots where two kegs overlap. Gangplank Q Parrrley and E Powder Keg are his main sources of physical damage, while Gangplank R Cannon Barrage can slow and damage you from afar.

Garen.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. More armor also makes Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield last effectively longer. However, armor cannot reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice, so get health too. If healing from Garen P Perseverance can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage’s brief defensive window ends, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land both empowered attacks, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle before Garen’s damage comes in. If Garen E Judgment keeps hitting you, don’t extend the combo; leave its range.
Garen.escape: The moment right after Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or its empowered attack is spent is an opportunity to engage. If Garen activates W Courage, wait out the brief shield and tenacity window, then land Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. Garen has no mobility, so if you catch him in this window, deal brief damage and back off.
Garen.fight: Start a short fight just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used. Engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, land both empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, then disengage so you don’t fight inside Garen E Judgment for long. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in.
Garen.phase: Turn your early to mid game jungle and objective control into a lead. As the game goes on, Garen becomes harder to deal with because of Garen W Courage’s stacking stats, and Udyr shifts toward a front line role.
Garen.teamfight: Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the enemy’s engage-stopping effect. Otherwise, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb incoming enemies. Once you’re in, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle, but if you’re below half health, get out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice.
Garen.watch: If you engage while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, its silence can stop your counterattack, so keep your distance until the empowered attack is used. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, leave its range. If you’re below half health, also stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice’s range, since its true damage scales with your missing health. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity, so delay Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun by half a beat after he uses it.

Gnar.build: Prioritize Plated Steelcaps and armor against Gnar’s main physical damage. More armor also helps Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield hold up more effectively. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage and percent max health damage, which armor or health alone won’t solve.
Gnar.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw, land both empowered attacks, then follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure. Don’t switch stances before using all of Q’s empowered attacks.
Gnar.escape: The moment right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch has been fully spent is a window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you expect Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR!, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to the moment its crowd control arrives. Avoid angles that could knock you into a wall as you engage.
Gnar.fight: Engage just after Mega Gnar returns to Mini Gnar or after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him, then deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in.
Gnar.laning: Instead of running straight through Mini Gnar’s ranged harass, approach from a brush or behind terrain when he pushes the lane and get behind him. Step out of Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss’s boomerang path so Gnar can’t catch it, opening a window before his next poke. Just after he transforms into Mega Gnar, create distance and let the transformation wear off.
Gnar.phase: Engage just after Gnar returns from Mega to Mini, while he can’t transform again. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on your front line role.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s Rage and try to start a team fight just after he returns from Mega to Mini. When fighting Mega Gnar, avoid narrow terrain and positions with your back to a wall. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the enemy’s engage-stopping effects. Otherwise, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb the enemy engage.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you on its return, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one.

Gragas.build: Gragas’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on maximum health, so rather than only stacking large amounts of health, also get movement speed to leave the barrels’ range. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw, land both empowered attacks, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle before Gragas’s heavy damage comes in. Decide which stance to Awaken before the fight, but use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened if you need to push through Gragas’s crowd control.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam is his only mobility ability, so go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede immediately after you make him use it. As he tries to stop your engage with E Body Slam, you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to ignore the crowd control.
Gragas.fight: If Gragas starts drinking, don’t commit heavy damage while the damage he takes is reduced. Right after Gragas E Body Slam is used, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and fight with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in.
Gragas.laning: If you walk in head-on, Gragas can escape with Gragas E Body Slam, so start from a brush or behind terrain, or approach when an ally applies crowd control. Get behind him when he pushes the lane, and alternate between ganks and clearing camps to secure early to mid game pressure. If you chase a fleeing Gragas too far, he can use E Body Slam again, so only chase when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.phase: At this point, Udyr should consolidate his gains through jungle and objective control, but keep the team’s formation from scattering during objective fights. Gragas’s sustained damage falls off late, making him easier to deal with, but Udyr should focus on the front line role.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t let your allies’ back line stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch narrow corridors and brush you have no vision of. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore Gragas’s engage-stopping crowd control. Otherwise, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle once you’re in.
Gragas.watch: If you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius. If Gragas E Body Slam also hits you near the barrel, the damage and crowd control stack, so use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened as the dash comes in to ignore the crowd control. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with the enemy team or a turret behind you.

Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor. Armor also helps Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield hold up.
Graves.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Land both empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and endure incoming damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken.
Graves.escape: Don’t engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Graves R Collateral Damage is also down or before it comes back up. If you’re hit by Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its range before approaching again.
Graves.fight: Counterattack in open terrain during the reload window after Graves has fired two basic attacks. Engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage comes in.
Graves.laning: Use your early camp clear and mobility to pressure the enemy jungle and objectives. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control; get behind enemies when they push the lane. If you approach head-on, Graves can escape with Graves E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: Graves gets harder to deal with over time as the stats he stacks with Graves E Quickdraw persist, so pressure his scaling early. In the late game, focus more on Udyr’s front line role and consolidate the lead you gained in the early to mid game.
Graves.teamfight: Put minions or allies between you and Graves to block Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks. Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the crowd control stopping your entry. If it’s hard to get in, stay beside your front line and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle once you’re in.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave it by the shortest route, then engage again. Graves gets harder to deal with as Graves E Quickdraw stacks defensive stats, so don’t let the fight drag on.

Hecarim.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is consumed after damage is reduced by defensive stats, so it also works well with armor. If healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Hecarim.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with the first attack, then switch to Q Wilding Claw and land both empowered attacks. Activate W Iron Mantle just before Hecarim’s heavy damage comes in. When switching stances afterward, stick to the basic rotation of using both empowered attacks.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows has also been used, or during the window before it comes back up, particularly R.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, disrupt Hecarim’s movement with the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm or the stun from E Blazing Stampede. Hecarim P Warpath converts bonus movement speed into attack damage, so disrupting his movement reduces both his approach and his damage.
Hecarim.laning: Udyr can move quickly between camps and keep clearing the jungle for a long time by maintaining health with stance switching. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or find an angle to engage when an ally applies crowd control.
Hecarim.phase: During Udyr’s peak in the early to mid game, consolidate your gains through jungle pressure and objective control. In the late game, Udyr shifts from a damage dealer toward a front line role, so focus on enduring damage and protecting your allies.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t feared together by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened can ignore the engage-stopping crowd control, then endure with W Iron Mantle once you’re in. If you can’t engage, stay beside your front line, keep up area damage and slows with R Wingborne Storm, and absorb Hecarim’s engage.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run. If Hecarim turns to build up distance, break vision or move closer to your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out during team fights.

Illaoi.build: Since Illaoi deals mostly physical damage, build armor first, and rush Plated Steelcaps if her damage is high. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If her healing can turn a duel, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Illaoi.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle, take damage as you land two empowered attacks, then move to the next stance.
Illaoi.escape: Right after you make Illaoi use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, go in during the window when there’s less risk of being caught.
Illaoi.fight: Pull Illaoi away from walls and tentacles before fighting. Right after she uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her, then deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before taking a large hit.
Illaoi.laning: Don’t fight where tentacles are set up near walls; stay in a lane position away from walls. Look for last hits outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. When ganking as Udyr, approach from a bush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally’s crowd control.
Illaoi.phase: In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so shift to holding the frontline. The available information isn’t enough to determine which champion is stronger in late-game duels.
Illaoi.teamfight: When facing Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out rather than grouping up so you don’t give her targets to hit during its duration. Destroy the tentacles or pull Illaoi into open ground away from walls. If awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can’t get you through engage-stopping effects, stay beside the frontline, keep up area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold off the enemy engage.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so dodge it as it flies toward you. If your spirit is pulled out, quickly decide whether you can fight. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t stay near the tentacles; create distance.

Irelia.build: Irelia’s main abilities, Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance, deal physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge can turn a duel, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Irelia.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage, and aim to land two empowered attacks each time you change stances.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after you make Irelia use her mobility tool, Irelia Q Bladesurge, is your window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you can predict when the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is coming, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede to push through the crowd control as you go in.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her, then deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Just before taking a large hit, activate the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; if you need to last longer, awaken Udyr W Iron Mantle to heal.
Irelia.laning: In lane against Irelia, don’t leave low-health minions between you and her; step back when minions are about to die. When ganking, start from a bush or behind terrain, or get behind her when she pushes the lane.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, you lack range and area damage, so shift to the frontline role.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia before she splits the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and stuns multiple people with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through crowd control that stops your engage, go in; once on her, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If it’s hard to engage, stay beside the frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold off Irelia’s engage.
Irelia.watch: Irelia can dash to low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Ivern.build: Prioritize movement speed to get out of Ivern’s telegraphed attack areas, and tenacity to prepare for crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and R Daisy!. If you’re building resistance to match Ivern’s ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle also blocks more actual damage for the same shield amount as your resistance stats increase.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage. If the target is affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, start this sequence after the shield bursts.
Ivern.escape: Right after you make Ivern use Ivern Q Rootcaller is your window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to push through as Q is flying toward you, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the immobilizing effect. If Ivern E Triggerseed is on the target, go in after it bursts.
Ivern.fight: When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him, then deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on the target, delay your engage until the shield bursts.
Ivern.laning: Get early vision in Ivern’s jungle to track which camps he seeded and when he’ll come to harvest them. Udyr can keep up jungle pressure and ganks with fast movement between camps and health management by alternating Udyr Q Wilding Claw and W Iron Mantle. Start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally’s crowd control, and watch out beside bushes created by Ivern.
Ivern.phase: The early and mid game are good times for Udyr to secure jungle and objective control. In the late game, Udyr shifts to the frontline role, so judge whether you can engage, then either hold your ground or hold off the enemy engage.
Ivern.teamfight: Engage when awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and R Daisy!. Once on them, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle, and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm where multiple enemies are grouped. If you can’t engage, handle the enemy engage beside the frontline and look for a chance to pick off an ally with a shield first.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller hits you, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so position with minions or terrain between you and Ivern before he casts it. If you immediately engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, you’ll be slowed when the shield bursts, so go in after it bursts. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move away to avoid being knocked up by three consecutive hits.

JarvanIV.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Before taking a large hit, activate the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, and aim to land two empowered attacks each time you change stances.
JarvanIV.escape: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede during the window when both mobility tools are down.
JarvanIV.laning: Instead of walking straight in as Udyr, start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or time them with an ally’s crowd control.

Jax.build: First consider defensive items that reduce attack speed to counter Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand the next damage. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t try to land the basic attack stun or empowered attacks.
Jax.escape: When you need to dodge the stun from Jax E Counter Strike, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to move outside its radius. If the stun is hard to avoid, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede as Counter Strike is reactivated to get through the crowd control. The window to go back in opens after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade window after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If he has just used Jax Q Leap Strike too, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him with your first basic attack, and deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before taking a large hit.
Jax.laning: Avoid close-range trades at level 1, and start building a CS and level lead from level 2 onward. Don’t use Udyr E Blazing Stampede just because you see Jax start Jax E Counter Strike; pressure him with your jungler after it ends. If Jax pushes the lane, approach from a bush or behind terrain to find an angle to get on him.
Jax.phase: Jax has the advantage in close-range trades at level 1, so avoid them.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike, don’t group nearby; focus crowd control right after the area stun ends. If awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through effects that stop your engage, go in; otherwise, stay beside the frontline and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once on them, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ paths.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw and the basic attack stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
