Stop attacking and step outside the stun radius; go back in after Counter Strike ends. Keep a way to create distance, since Jax can engage with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only add health. Also get movement speed to escape his telegraphed attack areas.
Jayce.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Just before taking a large hit, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand it. If you need to push through the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow, use awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to engage.
Jayce.escape: Right after you make Jayce use the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is your chance to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is still available, time awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to engage as the knockback comes.
Jayce.fight: Right after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you expect the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow, time awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to counter it.
Jayce.laning: When Jayce is holding the cannon, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast, and don’t overstay if health has dropped. Rather than starting a gank head-on, approach from a bush or behind terrain, or time it with an ally’s crowd control. If Jayce is pushing the lane, look for an angle to get behind him.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so if you start falling behind, farm defensively instead of trying to force a comeback. In the late game, shift to the frontline role and absorb the enemy's engage.
Jayce.teamfight: If Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, look for a chance to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through effects that stop your engage, go in; once on him, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If it’s hard to engage, stay beside the frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and absorb the enemy's engage.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, dodge to the side rather than staying in line, since Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow. If he’s holding the hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Karthus.build: Get movement speed first so you can escape the telegraphed area of Karthus Q Lay Waste and the area of E Defile more easily. Then build magic resistance to withstand Karthus’s magic damage. Be careful with your pathing, since crossing Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your resistance.
Karthus.combo: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to close in and stun Karthus with your first basic attack. Switch immediately to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand the damage just before it hits. Make use of two empowered attacks with each stance, but move out of Karthus P Death Defied's damage area after killing him.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no abilities to create distance on his own or immobilizing effects, so engage when you have an angle to reach him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Karthus W Wall of Pain has been placed, approach along a route that does not cross the wall. Walk out of the marked blast area of Karthus Q Lay Waste as you close in.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no way to create distance, so approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede from an angle that lets you get on top of him. After taking him down, move away immediately instead of continuing to fight by his corpse.
Karthus.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to approach from a brush or behind terrain, or flank Karthus while he is pushing the lane. Alternate between camps and ganks to turn early pressure into objective advantages.
Karthus.phase: In the mid game, press your objective and enemy jungle advantage to secure a lead. Karthus can catch up quickly if you give him time to farm. In the late game, Udyr has a greater frontline role, so avoid charging straight at Karthus recklessly.
Karthus.teamfight: If you can reach Karthus with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, pressure him with the stun and Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks, then use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand the damage before it hits. If you cannot engage, stay beside your frontline and keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow. Karthus leaves damage behind with Karthus P Death Defied even after you kill him, so reposition immediately.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage if it hits you alone, so walk out of its marked blast area. Karthus W Wall of Pain lowers your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Even after killing Karthus, immediately move away from his corpse to avoid Karthus P Death Defied's Lay Waste and E Defile.

Kayn.build: Build Plated Steelcaps and armor first to withstand the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases Kayn Q Reaping Slash's max-health damage. If healing in Darkin form can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Kayn.combo: When you can get on top of him, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack. Switch immediately to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then withstand his damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. After switching stances, make sure to get two empowered attacks in.
Kayn.escape: Don't engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down; check Kayn R Umbral Trespass as well. In particular, close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up. When Kayn W Blade's Reach is flying toward you, you can use awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to push through its disruptive effects and engage.
Kayn.fight: Pressure jungle routes and objectives early against Kayn before he transforms. From an angle where you can engage, stun him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands. If you need to survive for longer, heal with Udyr W Iron Mantle's Awakened effect.
Kayn.laning: Start from a brush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control, instead of walking straight in for a gank. If a warning appears at the edge of a wall where Kayn is, stop trading and retreat toward your turret. Early on, pressure Kayn's jungle routes by alternating between camps and ganks.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming early on, so use Udyr's jungle and objective pressure to delay his transformation. In the late game, shift to a frontline role and absorb the enemy's engage.
Kayn.teamfight: If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, be ready to stun Kayn with Udyr E Blazing Stampede as he emerges near the target. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect lets you pass through crowd control that would stop your engage. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline, keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow, and withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the linear hitbox of Kayn W Blade's Reach. If it hits, Kayn can enter from a long distance with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn uses Kayn E Shadow Step inside a wall, you can interrupt him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun.

Kennen.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, W Electrical Surge, and E Lightning Rush. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is consumed after resistance reduces the damage, so it becomes more effective with magic resistance.
Kennen.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Afterward, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and continue with two empowered attacks. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken; if you need to break through Kennen's stun, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect then.
Kennen.escape: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush has been spent is your opportunity to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm is about to stun you, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect for that moment.
Kennen.fight: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack. Follow with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Kennen.laning: In lane against Kennen, block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and briefly back off if Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks twice. When ganking as Udyr, start from a brush or behind terrain instead of walking in directly, or flank Kennen when he pushes the lane.
Kennen.phase: At this point, take advantage of Kennen E Lightning Rush being down to secure a lead. In the late game, withstand damage on the frontline with Udyr W Iron Mantle and keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow.
Kennen.teamfight: Don't stand on top of allies where Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can hit you, and use vision to block his entry paths. Engage when you can get past Kennen's stun with Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm; after closing in, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks twice, back off to avoid the third hit and stun. When Kennen engages with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, spread out from your allies to avoid an area stun.

Kindred.build: Build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early to prepare for Kindred's main damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and E Mounting Dread. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield also becomes more effective with armor. If healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and R Lamb's Respite can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Kindred.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to shield yourself just before taking heavy damage, and make use of two empowered attacks. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken.
Kindred.escape: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, Kindred can still create distance with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't engage hastily. Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, especially after her movement abilities are both down. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied and your health is low, stop chasing and avoid her repeated attacks.
Kindred.fight: Engage before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is placed, or look for an opening before it comes back up. Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks. If Kindred E Mounting Dread's repeated attacks become dangerous, use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand them while managing the distance.
Kindred.laning: Early on, use Udyr's fast movement between camps and sustain to gain vision on Kindred's jungle routes. Take marked camps first or guard the area nearby to slow Kindred P Mark of the Kindred's growth. Try ganking when you can close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede from a brush or behind terrain, or after an ally's crowd control, instead of walking in directly.
Kindred.phase: Secure marked camps and objective control through the mid game to slow Kindred's growth and range increase. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on your frontline role.
Kindred.teamfight: Look for a chance to reach Kindred with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, and time its Awakened effect if you need to pass through crowd control that would stop your engage. If you cannot engage, stay beside your frontline and keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow; after closing in, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, stay inside the zone so low-health allies can survive and make use of the heal when it ends.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, create distance or break vision to avoid taking repeated attacks. The follow-up damage becomes more dangerous as health decreases, so activate Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield just before it hits. Don't chase for long inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, where Kindred Q Dance of Arrows can keep creating distance.

Kled.build: Consider Plated Steelcaps and armor first, since Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting deal his main physical damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield also becomes more effective with defensive stats. Avoid stacking only health, since Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal max-health damage.
Kled.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Use Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand Kled's counterdamage just before it hits. Once Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun lands, don't stay in that stance; deal damage immediately.
Kled.escape: Don't engage just because Kled E Jousting is down. Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also unavailable. If you need to pass through Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope's pull, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment and push through with crowd control immunity.
Kled.fight: Avoid extended basic attack trades when Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready; if he activates it, back off and engage again later. Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to create distance before Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope pulls you in. When you have an angle to reengage, deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Kled.laning: Start from a brush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control, instead of walking straight in; then close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Kled dismounts from Skaarl, watch his courage bar and finish him when you can secure the kill. If you can't, create distance and push him out of lane so he can't build courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: In the early and mid game, turn Udyr's strengths into objective control and pressure on the enemy jungle. Kled weakens after lane and the mid game, but in the late game Udyr should also focus more on the frontline than dealing damage.
Kled.teamfight: Watch the flanks for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s long-range engage. If you can't stop it, stand in front as Udyr and protect your backline's formation. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect lets you pass through Kled's crowd control that would stop your engage. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline, keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow, and withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle after closing in.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. Kled W Violent Tendencies deals a burst of max-health damage on the fourth attack, so don't stay in range long enough to take all four when it's active. Watch for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engaging from out of vision by keeping an eye on the flanks.

KSante.build: K'Sante deals mostly physical damage, so prioritize Plated Steelcaps and armor. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes more effective with armor. Also build health to prepare for the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker, and add penetration to Udyr’s physical damage against K'Sante’s high armor.
KSante.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks, then withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, dodge the dash to the side instead of using your stun and damage, then start the combo. If you need to get through K'Sante’s crowd control to engage, decide before the fight whether to use awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
KSante.escape: Check that K'Sante has used both K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork before closing the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If only one is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t go in too early. The window before K'Sante R All Out comes back is especially good for engaging; when hard-to-dodge crowd control is coming, awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede to push through it.
KSante.fight: After K'Sante W Path Maker finishes charging and you dodge the dash, approach and deal max-health-based damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before K'Sante deals a large hit. The moment K'Sante R All Out activates and reduces his armor is a chance to focus your damage, but his damage and vamp also increase, so don’t tank him alone for long.
KSante.laning: Rather than walking straight in as Udyr, start ganks from a bush or behind terrain, or try to get behind K'Sante when he pushes the lane. In the early and mid game, use fast movement between camps and health sustain to keep up ganks, pressure on the enemy jungle, and objectives.
KSante.phase: In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on the frontline role.
KSante.teamfight: Engage when awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through K'Sante’s engage-stopping crowd control. If that’s difficult, stay beside the frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle once you’re on him. In a long fight while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure your team has healing reduction and don’t let K'Sante hit several people alone.
KSante.watch: If K'Sante hits you with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes repeatedly, step out of range of the next shockwave. K'Sante W Path Maker is unstoppable and reduces damage while charging, so watch the direction of his dash and dodge to the side. Don’t position with terrain behind you during a standoff, or K'Sante R All Out may knock you through a wall.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Lillia's main ability damage. Resistance does not work against the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, but Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on max health, so be careful about stacking only health. If Lillia's healing can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Lillia.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack. Switch immediately to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks, then withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If you need to withstand Lillia's damage over time for a long time, heal with Udyr W Iron Mantle's Awakened effect.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you make Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Engage when Lillia misses Lillia Q Blooming Blows and E Swirlseed and can't build movement speed stacks. If you've been hit by an ability that can trigger Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, get out during the drowsy window instead of chasing recklessly.
Lillia.fight: When Lillia misses her abilities and can't build movement speed stacks, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Use Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!'s heavy damage just before it hits.
Lillia.laning: Don't pass through narrow jungle entrances or river passages without confirming Lillia's position. Maintain your health by alternating Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr W Iron Mantle, and pressure the enemy jungle and objectives with fast movement between camps. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control.
Lillia.phase: At this point, dodge Lillia's abilities, take control, and consolidate your advantage. In the late game, Udyr shifts toward a frontline role, so stay near allies and absorb pressure instead of chasing Lillia blindly.
Lillia.teamfight: Save Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun for Lillia when she enters from the flank. Engage if Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect lets you pass through Lillia's engage-stopping effect; otherwise, stay beside your frontline and keep up Udyr R Wingborne Storm's area damage and slow. After closing in, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carry's path.
Lillia.watch: Getting hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed gives her movement speed stacks and fulfills the sleep condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. Be especially wary of Lillia E Swirlseed in narrow passages, and move to the side when you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!'s cast animation to avoid its center. If you are affected by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe place during the drowsy window before you fall asleep.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite’s main damage from Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Since Malphite has high armor, use Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s max-health damage instead of relying only on armor penetration.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks, then hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Malphite.escape: Hold off on engaging while slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, and don’t try to interrupt Malphite R Unstoppable Force with a stun.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then engage after the slow from Malphite Q Seismic Shard wears off. Once you’re on him, deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits.
Malphite.laning: Use the damage over time from Udyr R Wingborne Storm to keep Malphite P Granite Shield from recharging, but don’t stay within range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, Udyr fights while holding the frontline.
Malphite.teamfight: Space out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up multiple people, and don’t give him an opening to engage if his position is unknown. Counterattack once Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, and go in when Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect can let you pass through crowd control that would stop your engage. If it’s hard to get in, stay beside the frontline, keep dealing area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don’t start a fight right after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that can knock up multiple enemies, so don’t group near walls or brushes when you can’t see his position.

MasterYi.build: Build health too, since armor can’t reduce the true damage from E Wuju Style. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks, then hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, exploit his lack of mobility and go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Don’t use your stun during Q; land your first basic attack right after he lands. If Master Yi is likely to activate W Meditate, save Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun to interrupt the channel.
MasterYi.fight: If you meet Master Yi in the jungle early, you can fight him, and the moment after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends is your chance to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Master Yi’s heavy damage hits.
MasterYi.laning: Use your fast movement between camps and health sustain to pressure the enemy jungle and take objectives early. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally’s crowd control; if Master Yi has just used Q Alpha Strike, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
MasterYi.phase: Use the lead you gained by midgame to secure your advantage, and don’t give Master Yi, who gets stronger as the game goes on, time to scale. In the late game, Udyr should focus on protecting allies from the frontline rather than chasing damage dealers.
MasterYi.teamfight: Stun Master Yi with Udyr E Blazing Stampede the moment he lands after Q Alpha Strike, or interrupt W Meditate’s channel with a stun when he activates it. Move together so an ally doesn’t get caught alone and give Master Yi a chance to jump to another target. Once you’re on him, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block his path to your damage dealers.
MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is being cast, he can’t be targeted, so land Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm has no effect. Armor does not reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before heavy damage hits.

MonkeyKing.build: Build Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor against Wukong’s main damage. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes more effective with armor. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, and Wukong R Cyclone deals max-health damage, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health. If Wukong’s healing can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item.
MonkeyKing.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand the counterattack. After switching stances, get two empowered basic attacks in, and decide before the fight which stance to Awaken.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window to go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and before it comes back. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down too, it’s harder for him to respond with mobility. If you’re about to be hit by the knockup from Wukong R Cyclone, use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that timing.
MonkeyKing.laning: Use Udyr’s fast movement between camps and health sustain to take control of the jungle and objectives early. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally’s crowd control. If you approach head-on, Wukong can escape with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or E Nimbus Strike, so look for an opening after his mobility is down.
MonkeyKing.phase: However, choose short trades, since fighting Wukong for too long lets his armor and healing build up. Udyr’s role shifts toward the frontline in the late game, so secure the lead you gained in the early and midgame.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Look for a fight or objective right after Wukong R Cyclone is down. Go in if Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through crowd control that would stop your engage; otherwise, stay beside the frontline, maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
MonkeyKing.watch: Since Wukong E Nimbus Strike targets an enemy, start outside its range. Once you’re in close range, getting hit by Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and makes the ensuing trade unfavorable. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, don’t waste abilities on the clone left behind, and spread out from allies while Wukong R Cyclone is ready.

Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser’s main ability damage, and get some armor too to account for his basic attack damage. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle blocks more actual damage when your resistances are higher. If the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Mordekaiser.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to block damage and heal, and use that stance’s two empowered attacks before switching to the next stance. When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is coming, Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can let you push through the interruption.
Mordekaiser.escape: When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. However, if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, avoid engaging alone within its range.
Mordekaiser.fight: After Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp misses, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun him and deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Don’t commit your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates; focus him once the shield is worn down or converted into healing. If Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, withstand damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle while creating distance.
Mordekaiser.laning: Use Udyr’s fast movement between camps and health sustain to alternate between camps and ganks and take control in the early and midgame. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally’s crowd control to land Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. In narrow passages in front of Mordekaiser, space out from allies so he can’t pull you all in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp.
Mordekaiser.phase: At this point, keep cycling between camps and ganks to secure your lead through objectives and control of the enemy jungle. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus on holding the frontline.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Space out from allies so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp can’t pull multiple people in, and don’t enter Mordekaiser R Realm of Death’s range alone while it’s ready. When engaging, check whether Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the enemy crowd control that would stop your engage. If it’s hard to get in, stay beside the frontline and maintain slows and area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm; once you’re on the enemy, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block your opponents’ damage dealers’ path.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp pulls you in, he can follow up with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, so keep your distance in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off, and don’t stay close for long once it’s active. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel without help from your allies.

Nasus.build: Prioritize armor against Nasus’s main damage from Q Siphoning Strike. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle blocks more actual damage when your defensive stats are higher. Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them.
Nasus.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage and use its two empowered attacks. Decide before the fight which stance to Awaken, but if it becomes a long fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, use the sustained healing from Awakened Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Nasus.escape: The moment after Nasus W Wither is down is a good window to go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you land your stun, you can stay on him until he uses Flash. Don’t walk within Nasus’s range alone while Wither is still available.
Nasus.fight: If Nasus W Wither is down and you’re close enough to engage, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, then land empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Nasus’s heavy damage hits.
Nasus.phase: Use your jungle and objective control in the early and midgame to secure your lead. Nasus gets stronger as he stacks, while Udyr shifts to a frontline role in the late game, so it becomes harder to face Nasus head-on as the game goes on.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting head-on and keep your distance unless you have a clear advantage. Use the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm to hold off Nasus as he approaches, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Only engage deeply when Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the enemy crowd control that would stop your engage.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces both movement speed and attack speed, so don’t try to land empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw while affected by it. Leave Nasus E Spirit Fire, which reduces your armor while you’re standing on it. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, create distance and wait out its duration unless you have a clear advantage in numbers and damage.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance against Nidalee’s damage. If the healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Nidalee.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to hold your ground, but if heavy damage is expected right after Nidalee W Pounce, activate the shield before that damage hits. Decide which stance to Awaken before engaging.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you force Nidalee to use W Pounce is your chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Nidalee has no crowd control, so dodge her spears and traps as you approach, then hold her in place with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun once you’re on her.
Nidalee.fight: It’s better to dodge spears and traps before closing the gap. If Nidalee uses W Pounce to engage, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before heavy damage hits, then stun her with the first basic attack from Udyr E Blazing Stampede and deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Nidalee.laning: Use the movement speed from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to alternate between camps and lane ganks and take control in the early and midgame. Instead of walking in head-on, start from a brush or behind terrain, or engage after an ally applies crowd control. Check for and clear Nidalee W Bushwhack traps along jungle entrances and in the river beforehand with a Control Ward or area-of-effect ability.
Nidalee.phase: At this stage, dodge Nidalee’s spears and traps while securing your lead through control of the enemy jungle and objectives. In the late game, focus more on holding the frontline.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee stepped out to throw her spear, and look for a stun with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when you have an angle to get on her. If you can’t get close, stay beside the frontline, maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold off the enemy engage. Once you’re on the enemy, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block your opponents’ damage dealers’ path.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away it hits from, so be especially careful to dodge it at long range. Keep minions or your frontline allies between you and Nidalee, and watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack along jungle entrances and in the river. If you’re hit by a spear or trap, the Hunt mark makes Nidalee’s attacks after W Pounce dangerous.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first to withstand Nocturne’s main damage, and get Plated Steelcaps early. The higher your defensive stats, the more damage Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield effectively blocks. If Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ healing can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to withstand damage and land two empowered basic attacks. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to break the spell shield first, then switch to your next stance, accounting for the blocked stun.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is on you, create distance to break the tether, or use Awaken Udyr E when the fear is about to trigger to resist the crowd control.
Nocturne.fight: Close in and fight with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Nocturne R Paranoia is down. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to break the spell shield first, then apply the stun and damage after it disappears. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits, and Awaken W to heal if you need to stay alive longer.
Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances, and find a safe place to fall back to before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated. Use Udyr’s fast movement between camps and ability to stay healthy to alternate between camps and ganks and take control in the early and mid game. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or try them when an ally applies crowd control and gives you an angle to close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Nocturne.phase: In the early and mid game, consolidate your lead through jungle pressure and objective fights, and look for opportunities when Nocturne R Paranoia is down. In the late game, shift Udyr’s role toward the frontline and protect your allies.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your vision, move toward your allies so no one gets isolated. Engage when Awaken Udyr E can get you through the enemy’s crowd control that stops engages. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow; once you’re in, hold out with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, he can quickly approach along its trail, so don’t retreat in a straight line; angle toward an ally or turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if the tether remains connected, so keep a way to create distance immediately after it lands. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don’t stray off alone; move toward your allies at once.

Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and get tenacity to account for the snowball’s crowd control. If the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Nunu.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun from your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to hold your ground, and get two empowered basic attacks each time you switch stances. If you need to pass through the snowball’s crowd control to engage, time Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede for that moment.
Nunu.escape: The moment after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! passes, or after you dodge the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, is your chance to get on them with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Nunu & Willump have no ability to create distance on their own, so if you have an opening to get close, catch them with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun.
Nunu.fight: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun, then deal health-based damage with empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Use Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb heavy damage just before it hits.
Nunu.laning: Watch for Nunu & Willump to return after ganking once, possibly by way of the Scuttle Crab. Start Udyr’s ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or time them with an ally’s crowd control when you can get on the enemy.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on holding the frontline.
Nunu.teamfight: Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero is a channel, so interrupt it with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun to prevent the burst damage. If you can’t get close enough to interrupt it, leave the area before the slow intensifies. Go in when Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through crowd control that would stop your engage; otherwise, stay beside the frontline, maintain area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so watch for the snowball approaching from outside vision. Instead of running away with the snowball behind you, move toward it and escape along the path Nunu & Willump came from. If you’re hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, immediately move out of the way before the follow-up root.

Olaf.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor against Olaf’s physical damage. The shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes more effective with armor, but is less effective while Olaf Q Undertow reduces your armor. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so build health too.
Olaf.combo: When Olaf R Ragnarok is not active, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Olaf’s counterattack. Get two empowered attacks when switching stances, and decide which stance to Awaken before engaging.
Olaf.escape: The window to engage is after you’ve prevented Olaf from retrieving the axe from Q Undertow. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, but if Olaf R Ragnarok is active, save Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun and use it right after Ragnarok ends.
Olaf.fight: When Olaf can’t retrieve his axe, get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, and deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits, and use Awakened W to heal if you need to hold out for a long time. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal when his health has decreased, so don’t drag out a fight you can’t finish.
Olaf.laning: Move in the opposite direction from where Olaf Q Undertow lands to stop him from retrieving the axe. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or get on Olaf with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after an ally’s crowd control lands. Instead of walking in head-on, get behind him when he pushes the wave.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strongest early, so don’t give him unnecessary kills in the early game. Olaf is relatively weaker in the late game, while Udyr’s role shifts toward the frontline.
Olaf.teamfight: If Udyr can get through the enemy’s engage-stopping effects with Awakened E, go in; otherwise, stay beside the frontline and maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you’re on the enemy, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block your opponents’ damage dealers’ path.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows you, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when your health is low, use Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield and healing or create distance. Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun doesn’t work during Olaf R Ragnarok, so create distance and stun him after it ends.

Ornn.build: Starting with your first defensive item, build both armor and magic resistance rather than focusing on only one resistance. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while W Bellows Breath and R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield also becomes more effective as your resistances increase. Since Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your max health, avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Ornn.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Ornn with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Switch to Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Ornn's heavy damage hits and hold your ground. Keep to the basic rotation of two empowered attacks each time you switch stances.
Ornn.escape: Don't go in just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; look for a window when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is down too. In particular, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to close the gap before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. If you're about to be hit by his remaining crowd control, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to go through it.
Ornn.fight: Fight in open ground away from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture's pillar and walls. If you can read when Ornn's crowd control is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to push through it and get on him. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands.
Ornn.laning: Pressure Ornn, whose early damage is low, but don't fight beside Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture's pillar or beside walls. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to close in and attack, interrupting the craft. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, wait for the effect to expire before stepping forward again.
Ornn.phase: Consolidate your advantage through Udyr's jungle pressure and objective control through the mid game, getting ahead before Ornn accumulates items and masterwork upgrades for his allies. In late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on frontline duty.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, and watch for the second charge as well. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control that would stop your engage, go in. Once you're on them, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries' path. If you can't get through, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to keep up area damage and slows while stopping the enemy engage.
Ornn.watch: Near Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture's pillar or walls, Ornn E Searing Charge's shockwave can knock you up, so move toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath's final flame makes you Brittle, create distance and wait for the effect to expire. Step aside from the path of the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and stay out of the straight line where Ornn will headbutt it back.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield absorbs damage after armor reduces it, making armor especially effective for survivability. Pantheon has high armor, so add penetration if your damage is lacking.
Pantheon.combo: When engaging, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Pantheon with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Pantheon's counterattack lands. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or move around to the side to attack.
Pantheon.escape: The window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. Pantheon can chain his escape tools, so don't engage just because one is down. If you have to go in while being hit by Pantheon W Shield Vault, press Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect at that moment to pass through the stun.
Pantheon.fight: While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, wait to attack or move around to the side to land Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered attacks. If heavy damage is coming, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before it hits.
Pantheon.laning: Don't give Pantheon a kill early, and stand behind minions when he uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain instead of walking straight in, or follow up after an ally's crowd control. Udyr can maintain his health by switching stances, so alternate between camps and ganks to build an experience and vision advantage.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off in late game, but Udyr also takes on more frontline duty, so convert your early and mid-game lead into a lasting advantage.
Pantheon.teamfight: Engage when you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through a stun that would stop your engage, such as Pantheon W Shield Vault. If that opportunity isn't there, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to damage and slow multiple enemies while stopping their engage. Once you're on them, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries' path.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets you directly and stuns, so be careful not to give him range. If you can read when the leap is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before the damage lands. When you see the landing marker for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to prepare for Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield also blocks more actual damage as your armor increases. Be careful about stacking a lot of health alone, since Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun from your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Poppy's heavy damage hits. Use two empowered attacks in each stance, and decide which stance to use Awakened on before the fight.
Poppy.escape: The window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is right after you force Poppy to use E Heroic Charge. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash; wait for its duration to end. If you can read when Poppy's stun or knockback is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to engage without being affected by the crowd control.
Poppy.fight: Fight in open ground without a wall behind you to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge's wall collision. When Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends or Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack. Follow with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits.
Poppy.laning: Don't stand with a wall or narrow passage behind you, to avoid Poppy E Heroic Charge's wall collision. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador drops, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield. Instead of forcing an approach from the front, start from a brush or behind terrain, or time your entry with an ally's crowd control.
Poppy.phase: Use the window while Poppy E Heroic Charge is down to consolidate your control at this point in the game. In late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so shift to holding the frontline.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't dash with Udyr E Blazing Stampede while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Engage if you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through Poppy's crowd control as it comes in. If engaging is difficult, stay beside your frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks Udyr E Blazing Stampede's dash, so wait for it to end or walk up to her. If the first hit of Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the area before its second explosion. When you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, step sideways out of her path.

Quinn.build: Quinn's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield boosts your effective survivability alongside armor.
Quinn.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Quinn with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb damage. If you can read when Quinn E Vault is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is right after Quinn E Vault is down. If Quinn E Vault is still available, make her use it first, then close the gap once you confirm it's down.
Quinn.fight: Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after Quinn E Vault is down.
Quinn.laning: Early on, don't force fights within Quinn's range; protect your CS and health. Farm while you aren't marked, and start a trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives.
Quinn.phase: In the early lane phase, Quinn uses her range to pressure Udyr, so protect your health and wait for an opportunity. Udyr is strong at jungle pressure and objective fights in the early and mid game, so consolidate your advantage then and focus on frontline duty in late game.
Quinn.teamfight: Go in when you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control that would stop your engage. If you can't engage, stay beside your frontline and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Use the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to catch Quinn when she comes in from the side.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step outside her basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Quinn E Vault knocks away and slows Udyr when he closes in, so don't force your way onto her while this ability is available.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Prioritize tenacity too if crowd control is getting you killed. Don't focus on piling physical damage into Rammus's high armor.
Rammus.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Rammus with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. When it's your turn to take damage, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, wait until it ends before using empowered attacks.
Rammus.escape: If you can read when Rammus's crowd control is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through it and engage. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt has already landed, you can move once it ends.
Rammus.fight: Stop basic attacking and create distance when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. Once its reflected damage and increased defenses are gone, deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. If you need to hold out for a long time, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before heavy damage hits.
Rammus.laning: Keep your health up while clearing camps with Udyr Q Wilding Claw and W Iron Mantle, and use your fast movement to take control between the jungle and lanes. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow an ally's crowd control with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Put minions between you and Rammus in advance where Rammus Q Powerball is likely to come through.
Rammus.phase: Shift to frontline duty in late game, catching Rammus's engage and creating space for your team to move.
Rammus.teamfight: If Rammus rolls in quickly with Q Powerball, watch for the expanded area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and leave the landing spot. Engage when you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control that would stop your engage. If that opportunity isn't there, stay beside your frontline and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, holding your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle as you stop the enemy engage.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball coming, put minions between you and him to make him collide with them. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is a targeted ability, and once it lands you can't move or use abilities, so prepare before you enter its range. Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast after he rolls in quickly, covers a wider area and continues to slow at the landing point, so back away far enough and then leave that spot.

RekSai.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first to prepare for Rek'Sai's main physical damage. You can't reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel with armor, but Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai can turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
RekSai.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun from your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits. If Rek'Sai Burrows to heal, keep up the damage over time and slow with Udyr R Wingborne Storm.
RekSai.escape: If you dodge the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, use the window after she loses her way to keep you in place to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so check which mobility tools she has left. In particular, look for an engage before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back up.
RekSai.fight: Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before the heavy damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel hits.
RekSai.laning: Early on, account for Rek'Sai's ganks: don't cross areas without vision alone or push your lane too far. If you see an entrance from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near a lane or in your own jungle, walk over it to destroy it. Udyr can move quickly between camps and keep his health up, so take control by moving between camps and gank opportunities where you can get on a target.
RekSai.phase: Consolidate your advantage through Udyr's jungle pressure and objective fights in the early and mid game. If you prevent Rek'Sai from getting ahead early, the matchup improves as the game goes on. In late game, Udyr should focus on frontline duty instead of chasing carries.
RekSai.teamfight: When stopping Rek'Sai's engage, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect as Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow hits to pass through the crowd control. If there isn't an opening to engage, stay beside your frontline and keep up the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you're on them, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and physically block the enemy carries' path.
RekSai.watch: Watch for Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to knock you up as she bursts out of the ground. When you see her Burrow, leave narrow paths and move toward open ground. Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect as she emerges to pass through the crowd control. Immediately after Rek'Sai damages you, Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow, so stay close to your allies.

Renekton.build: Renekton's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield boosts your effective survivability alongside armor. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton E Slice and Dice or W Ruthless Predator is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks, then hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use two empowered basic attacks in each stance before switching.
Renekton.escape: The window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is right after Renekton uses E Slice and Dice. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is down too, you have less reason to worry about being stunned, so counterattack based on which of his other abilities he's used.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton P Reign of Anger is empty. Immediately after Renekton has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and counterattack. If you can read the stun timing from Renekton W Ruthless Predator, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through it. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits.
Renekton.laning: Don't stand in or behind a group of minions where Renekton E Slice and Dice can use them to set up an engage. Use the moments when Renekton steps forward to build Fury as an opportunity to poke, and keep your distance when his Fury is full. When backing away after taking his combo, move in a direction with no targets for Renekton E Slice and Dice to dash through.
Renekton.phase: Udyr is strong at jungle pressure and objective fights in the early and mid game, so turn that control into an advantage. Renekton's value declines from mid game onward, so keep farming without giving up kills and take on frontline duty in late game.
Renekton.teamfight: Engage when you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through a stun that would stop your engage, such as Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If that opportunity isn't there, stay beside your frontline and keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm while stopping the enemy engage. Once you're on them, hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries' path.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is around half full or higher, watch for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. This ability breaks shields first and then stuns, so don't enter its range when his Fury is full relying only on Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to set up a second dash, so avoid standing in or behind a group of minions.

Rengar.build: Rengar's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield blocks more actual damage as your armor increases. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Rengar.combo: After confirming Rengar W Battle Roar is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then absorb damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use two empowered attacks in each stance before moving to the next.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you can't avoid the timing of the root, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control and engage.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun him, then deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Rengar's heavy damage hits.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brushes and use Control Ward to secure vision in them. Use the movement speed from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to move between camps and lanes, but start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or when an ally has already applied crowd control. If the enemy has pushed the lane, approach from behind.
Rengar.phase: At this point, choose a moment when Rengar's resource bar is empty to fight, and secure control of the enemy jungle and objectives. In late game, switch to catching engages from the frontline.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your team so your backline stays behind the frontline and within your team's vision, and counter Rengar's leap. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, stun him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to keep him in place. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect to pass through the crowd control that would stop your engage, go in. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold your ground with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Rengar.watch: When Rengar's resource bar is full, his next ability is empowered, so avoid trading. Watch in particular for the root from empowered Rengar E Bola Strike and the crowd control cleanse from empowered Rengar W Battle Roar, and fight after Rengar W Battle Roar is down.

Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early. The more armor you have, the more damage Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield effectively absorbs.
Riven.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Riven with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks. Absorb damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle, and get two empowered attacks whenever you change stances.
Riven.escape: Riven can escape by chaining Riven Q Broken Wings with Riven E Valor, so don’t engage just because one mobility ability is down.
Riven.fight: As soon as Riven gets on you, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun to interrupt the rest of her combo. After the stun, switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before her heavy damage lands.
Riven.laning: If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, she has spent both her main damage and her escape, so look for a counterattack. When ganking, start from a brush or behind terrain instead of approaching head-on, or get behind her when she pushes the lane.
Riven.phase: In the early and mid game, consolidate your advantage through jungle and objective control. In the late game, focus more on frontline duty.
Riven.teamfight: When Riven engages, interrupt her combo with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun and survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Engage if you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the enemy’s engage-stopping crowd control. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to maintain area damage and slows.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings is dangerous because of its repeated dashes and knock-up, so create distance as soon as you see the first dash. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and the finishing damage based on missing health is threatening, so avoid her until it expires.

Rumble.build: Choose a first defensive item with magic resistance. Rumble’s main damage is magic damage, and the more magic resistance you have, the more damage Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield effectively absorbs. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Rumble with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Rumble’s counterattack lands. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun connects, don’t stay in that stance.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the brief movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield ending is a good window to engage. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, first decide whether to use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to create distance before the second shot arrives. If you need to push through a slow to engage, time Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede for that moment.
Rumble.fight: Right after Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, don’t pour damage into the shield; wait it out briefly. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Rumble’s damage lands.
Rumble.laning: Take fewer trades where you stay close in front of Rumble and get hit by Rumble Q Flamespitter; instead, create situations where he has to walk forward. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow an ally’s crowd control to land Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first basic attack. Use Udyr’s fast camp rotations and health sustain to alternate between camps and ganks.
Rumble.phase: At this point, use the engage window when Rumble W Scrap Shield is down to consolidate objective and enemy jungle control. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on frontline duty.
Rumble.teamfight: Engage when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through crowd control that would stop your engage. Once you’re on them, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle and body-block the enemy carries’ path. If it’s hard to engage, stay beside your frontline, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow, and hold off incoming enemies.
Rumble.watch: If you’re hit by both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, the slow becomes much stronger and your magic resistance is reduced. If the first shot hits, don’t stand your ground; use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to create distance before the second shot arrives. Rumble Q Flamespitter damages you while you’re close, so keep your distance unless you’re fighting.

Sett.build: Given the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down, get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. The more armor you have, the more damage Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield effectively absorbs. Armor can’t reduce the true damage in the center of Sett W Haymaker, so position yourself to dodge it.
Sett.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Sett with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to survive Sett’s counterattack, activating it before heavy damage lands if Sett W Haymaker is coming. If Sett’s Grit is high after you deal damage, create distance briefly.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, the stun threat is lower. If you need to engage when Sett E Facebreaker is about to hit, time Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the crowd control.
Sett.fight: After building Sett’s Grit, don’t keep fighting him; back off, then engage again. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Sett W Haymaker lands, and move out of the center of its aim.
Sett.laning: Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain instead of walking straight in, or approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after an ally applies crowd control. If Sett pushes the lane, a gank from behind is reliable. Rotate between camps and ganks to expand your early and mid game control with Udyr’s fast movement and health sustain.
Sett.phase: In the late game, Udyr’s role shifts closer to frontline than carry, so secure the lead you built early and mid game.
Sett.teamfight: Engage when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through engage-stopping effects such as Sett E Facebreaker. If it’s hard to engage, stay beside your frontline, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow, and hold off enemy engages. Once you’re on them, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle and dodge the center of Sett W Haymaker’s aim.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes damage, so back off after dealing damage and wait for his Grit to fade. If Sett W Haymaker is hard to dodge, sidestep the center of its aim to avoid the true damage. Avoid positions where allies or minions are on both sides of Sett so you don’t get stunned by Sett E Facebreaker.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. Magic resistance won’t help against the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive, so get some health too, and pick up movement speed to leave dangerous areas when they’re telegraphed.
Shaco.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and land the stun with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks, then survive Shaco’s damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle just before it lands. Get two empowered basic attacks whenever you change stances.
Shaco.escape: Right after you force Shaco to use Q Deceive, he can’t immediately escape with the same ability, so close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to push through the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive is your chance to close the gap and fight. Get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him with your first basic attack, and deal damage with two empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Shaco’s heavy damage lands.
Shaco.laning: Early on, keep vision at your team’s jungle entrances to watch for Shaco ganks and invades. Use Udyr’s fast camp rotations and health sustain to move between camps and ganks, but only gank when you can approach from a brush or behind terrain. Check for Shaco W Jack In The Box around an objective before starting it.
Shaco.phase: In the early and mid game, secure your lead with Udyr’s jungle pressure and objective control without giving up kills. In the late game, Shaco is less effective in isolated fights, and Udyr shifts toward frontline duty.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco appears after using Shaco Q Deceive to enter, immediately focus him down with your allies. Watch the health bar so you don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone; when it dies, move away from its explosion and the box’s fear. Engage if you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through engage-stopping effects. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to fend off enemy engages.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for Shaco W Jack In The Box fear in brushes without vision and around objectives. Clear boxes first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens, then adjust your direction after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive so he can’t get behind you for his empowered first basic attack. Watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when your health is low.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so avoid building only one type of resistance or health. Armor and magic resistance also improve Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield efficiency.
Shen.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Shen with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, hold Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks until the field ends.
Shen.escape: When Shen E Shadow Dash misses, both his mobility and hard crowd control are down, giving you a window to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Also watch whether Shen R Stand United is available; if it isn’t ready, use that as an opening to engage.
Shen.fight: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to stun him and deal damage. While Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, don’t use Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks; land both after the field ends.
Shen.laning: Early on, take control with trades and push the lane to keep Shen occupied with CS.
Shen.phase: Early on, use Shen’s weak laning to take control. In the late game, hold the frontline with Udyr W Iron Mantle and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm against multiple enemies.
Shen.teamfight: Engage when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. If you don’t have that opening, stay beside your frontline, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and fend off enemy engages. Once you’re on them, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’re likely to take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Dodge the dash or Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede as it comes in to get through the crowd control. Also move out of the path of Shen’s spirit blade as it returns to him to reduce damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, and also get armor against her basic attacks’ physical damage. Resistance can’t stop the true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike, and she also deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If Shyvana’s healing is enough to swing a duel, fit Executioner’s Calling in after completing one core item.
Shyvana.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Shyvana with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb damage and survive. Get two empowered basic attacks whenever you change stances, and decide which stance to Awaken before entering the fight.
Shyvana.escape: Don’t try to stop Shyvana with a stun while she’s dashing with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent; catch her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after she lands. Also counterattack when Shyvana returns to human form and loses her bonus health and empowered abilities. Look for an opening to approach if her Fury is empty or she has used her engage tool, Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury is empty, and don’t start an objective in front of her when it’s full. When you see an opening to get on her, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun her, and deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks. In a fight where Shyvana stays close and deals damage for a long time, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle; if you need to take damage over time for an extended period, use Awakened W to heal.
Shyvana.laning: Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control; get behind the enemy when they push the lane. Choose an angle where Udyr E Blazing Stampede can reliably get you onto them instead of walking straight in.
Shyvana.phase: In the mid game, use Udyr’s strengths to secure your lead. The matchup becomes unfavorable as stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail build up over time, and in the late game Udyr also shifts closer to frontline duty than carry.
Shyvana.teamfight: Space out from your allies so you don’t overlap with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path or the area damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst. Once Shyvana’s dash ends and she lands, stun her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle after you get on her. In a team fight with multiple enemies close together, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow to peel for allies against Shyvana.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health to survive. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so stun her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after she lands. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage, such as the explosion from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, lands.

Singed.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling. Magic resistance also increases the actual damage absorbed by Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield. Get movement speed to leave areas covered in poison, and avoid stacking health alone given that Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health.
Singed.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, land the stun with your first basic attack, and immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw. After two empowered basic attacks, survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If you can read when Singed E Fling is coming, use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the crowd control and approach.
Singed.escape: You can’t engage through an area covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so go around it before engaging.
