Close the gap when Singed E Fling is down or when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through its crowd control. Singed has no ability to create distance himself, so don’t hesitate when you have an opening to catch him.
Singed.fight: When Singed is running away while leaving poison, stop chasing unless you still have enough damage to finish him reliably. When you have an opening to get on him, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw for two empowered basic attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before taking damage, and use its Awakened form to set up healing if you have to stay in poison for a long time.
Singed.laning: When ganking as Udyr, start from a brush or behind terrain and get behind Singed when he pushes the lane. Don’t walk in from the front along his poison trail and chase him for a long time.
Singed.phase: In the mid game, secure your lead with Udyr’s jungle pressure and objective control, but don’t chase Singed recklessly once he has his core items. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus on frontline duty.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed runs at you, stun him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then fight his allies instead of chasing him to the end. Engage when you can use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through engage-stopping crowd control. If it’s hard to engage, stay beside your frontline, maintain Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow, and survive with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t move through Singed W Mega Adhesive with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, it also roots you, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back toward an allied formation, he can throw you into that formation with Singed E Fling, so check the rear positioning before approaching.

Sion.build: Sion's main abilities—P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught—deal physical damage, so build armor first. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield blocks more damage as your armor increases. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone.
Sion.combo: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, then approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before Sion's retaliation lands to endure it.
Sion.escape: The moment after dodging the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash is also an opening to engage. If you have to push through unavoidable crowd control to get in, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
Sion.fight: When Sion Q Decimating Smash charges, move sideways to dodge it. If it is hard to avoid, pressure him by getting close and forcing him to release it early. When you cannot avoid a heavy hit, activate Udyr W Iron Mantle before it lands.
Sion.laning: Sion gains maximum health as he kills units, so keep him from farming freely by pushing the lane to disrupt him or creating advantages in other lanes. When looking for a gank, approach from a brush or behind terrain after Sion has pushed the lane. Find an angle that lets you get close instead of walking straight at him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Sion.phase: Keep disrupting Sion's farming or secure advantages elsewhere in the meantime. As Sion builds maximum health over time, he becomes harder to fight, and in the late game Udyr should focus on frontlining.
Sion.teamfight: Engage when Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past the engage-stopping effects of Sion Q Decimating Smash or R Unstoppable Onslaught. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm to absorb Sion's engage. Once you close in, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If Sion revives with P Glory in Death, create distance and reposition.
Sion.watch: The knock-up and stun from Sion Q Decimating Smash become more dangerous the longer it charges, so move to the side as soon as the charge starts. Avoid meeting Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path and dodge to the side of its direction. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you, so sidestep it before engaging.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal's Impact deal physical damage, which magic resistance alone cannot mitigate. Since he also deals damage based on maximum health, consider resistances and movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas instead of stacking health alone.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then continue with Udyr W Iron Mantle as you take damage. Use two empowered attacks in each stance before switching to the next.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his only mobility tool, so right after you force him to use it is your window to go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If his dash hits a wall, its cooldown is greatly reduced, so account for another dash and back off. Skarner R Impale cannot be interrupted by Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun, so do not treat that stun as a way to break suppression.
Skarner.fight: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Once you are on him, fight with the maximum-health-based empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before the heavy damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval lands. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, do not fight with a wall at your back.
Skarner.laning: Udyr maintains his health by switching stances and takes early jungle control by alternating between camps and lane ganks. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally's crowd control. Pressure the enemy jungle and objectives before Skarner gets tank items.
Skarner.phase: Use this window to take control and delay Skarner's tank items. In the late game, Udyr shifts toward frontlining, so stay near your team and absorb the enemy engage.
Skarner.teamfight: When Skarner tries to stop your engage with E Ixtal's Impact, check whether Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the interrupting effect before going in. If you cannot engage, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm to absorb the enemy engage. Skarner R Impale ignores terrain and drags you, so do not stand against the edge of the dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain. If he hits a wall, it stuns and its cooldown is greatly reduced. Fight in open space without putting a wall at your back, and watch for another dash if he hits a wall. Skarner R Impale suppresses you and cannot be interrupted by Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench's main sources of damage: P An Acquired Taste, Q Tongue Lash, and W Abyssal Dive. Tahm Kench R Devour deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. If healing would swing the duel, slot in Executioner's Calling after finishing one core item; consider penetration against high armor.
TahmKench.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack, then switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to absorb damage, and get two empowered attacks each time you switch stances. If you have to push through the stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive to engage, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede at that moment.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, giving you a chance to get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you can tell when the crowd control from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is coming, engage through it with Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If two stacks have already built up, delay your engage and look for an opening again after they fall off.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield or healing, so engage when you can deal damage in one burst instead of trading small hits and backing off. Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, then deal maximum-health-based damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Tahm Kench's heavy damage lands.
TahmKench.laning: Udyr's ganks are more reliable when started from a brush or behind terrain, or after an ally applies crowd control, than when walking straight at the target. If Tahm Kench is pushing the lane, get behind him and approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you have been hit twice by basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, do not continue the fight; back off until the stacks fall off.
TahmKench.phase: Use the maximum-health-based damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw in duels and objective fights. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so hold the frontline and absorb the enemy engage.
TahmKench.teamfight: Pressure the carry Tahm Kench is protecting instead of focusing him first, but account for Tahm Kench R Devour saving the carry while it is available. If you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies. If an ally is devoured, focus your damage on Tahm Kench. Engage if Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the crowd control stopping your engage. If that is difficult, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
TahmKench.watch: When stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste reach three from basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, he can stun you and set up Tahm Kench R Devour. If you have been hit twice, move out of range and wait for the stacks to fall off. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against Taliyah's main sources of damage, Q Threaded Volley and E Unraveled Earth. Udyr can block immobilizing effects with Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so use it when Taliyah W Seismic Shove and E Unraveled Earth are about to hit.
Taliyah.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack, then switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands, and use two empowered basic attacks each time you switch stances.
Taliyah.escape: Do not engage just because Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down. Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Taliyah also cannot use R Weaver's Wall. If you can tell when the forced movement from Taliyah W Seismic Shove is coming, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the interrupting effect.
Taliyah.fight: Taliyah has low armor, so Udyr's main physical damage is effective; fight when you have an angle to get close. Approach while dodging Taliyah Q Threaded Volley to the side, and if she lays down rocks, go around them instead of dashing across them with Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Taliyah.laning: Use the movement speed from Udyr E Blazing Stampede to move between camps and ganks, but start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up after an ally applies crowd control. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, suspect a rotation to another lane using her movement speed near walls and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, and back off early.
Taliyah.phase: Watch for Taliyah's fast rotations to other lanes, and shift Udyr toward a frontline role in the late game.
Taliyah.teamfight: Engage when Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you past the engage-stopping effects of Taliyah W Seismic Shove and E Unraveled Earth. If that is difficult, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm to absorb the enemy engage, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle once you are on them.
Taliyah.watch: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth lays down rocks, she can soon use Taliyah W Seismic Shove to push you across them, so move away from the rocks immediately. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while casting, so dodge to the side instead of charging straight at her.

Teemo.build: Buy magic resistance items first against the damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap. Increasing your defensive stats also makes Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield more effective at blocking actual damage.
Teemo.combo: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle. While blinded by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, do not force empowered attacks; wait for the blind to end.
Teemo.escape: A good window to get on Teemo with Udyr E Blazing Stampede is after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and he has also used Teemo W Move Quick.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, then deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Teemo deals heavy damage.
Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where you only take basic attacks in Teemo's range and back off. When you go in, close the distance fully with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Check bushes without vision with a Control Ward or go around them to account for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare. If looking for a gank, approach from a brush or behind terrain when Teemo has pushed the lane.
Teemo.phase: Act early, since Teemo's R Noxious Trap will accumulate on key paths if you give him time. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so switch to a frontline role.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages before engaging. If you can get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him. If it is hard to reach him, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you are on him, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy damage dealer's path.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart nullifies the empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, so deal damage with basic attacks after the blind ends or Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even from a single basic attack, so stay out of range if you are not ready to commit. Watch for Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow paths.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield works better with higher defensive stats, but while Trundle R Subjugate is active, prioritize creating distance over stacking more resistances to fight him. If his healing could swing the duel, slot in Executioner's Calling after finishing one core item.
Trundle.combo: After leaving Trundle W Frozen Domain, get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Get two empowered attacks in each stance to make use of its effect.
Trundle.escape: Engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you can fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. You can block the pillar's forced movement with Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede at the moment it hits, but the pillar itself is impassable terrain, so move around it. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can keep pressuring him once you catch him.
Trundle.fight: Stay outside Trundle W Frozen Domain and let it expire, and do not continue the duel while Trundle R Subjugate is active. When you go back in, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, and deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands to endure it.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a nearby enemy unit dies, so do not linger beside a large wave merely chipping away at health. If you have reduced his health, secure an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall. Udyr maintains his health by switching stances and alternates between camps and ganks; start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or follow up on an ally's crowd control.
Trundle.phase: In the mid game, use Udyr's fast movement to secure control of the enemy jungle and objectives, but avoid solo duels after Trundle gets R Subjugate.
Trundle.teamfight: While Trundle R Subjugate is active, do not face him alone at the front; attack another target or create distance. Engage if Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the crowd control stopping your engage. If you cannot engage, stay beside your frontline and maintain the area damage and slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle once you are on them and block the enemy damage dealer's path.
Trundle.watch: Inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed, movement speed, and healing increase, so do not fight there; back off and let it expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape in narrow paths and slows nearby enemies, so fight in open terrain and move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and steals armor and magic resistance, so create distance while it is active.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield improves your survivability along with your armor. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust could swing the duel, buy Executioner's Calling after finishing one core item.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure the damage.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after baiting out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your chance to close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If possible, fight in terrain without minions, and land the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede just after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, it reduces your attack damage, so do not start a basic attack trade right away.
Tryndamere.fight: Harass Tryndamere before he builds Fury by hitting minions, and do not force basic attack trades if he has built it up. After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, get on him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, and deal damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands, and create distance while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.laning: Harass Tryndamere early to keep him from building Fury by hitting minions; this also limits his critical strikes and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. If ganking as Udyr, approach from a brush or behind terrain when Tryndamere pushes the lane. Do not chase him among many minions; look for a chance to stun him after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down.
Tryndamere.phase: Harass Tryndamere before he builds Fury during this phase, and use the opening while Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down to secure control. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so he should focus more on frontlining.
Tryndamere.teamfight: When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede and create distance instead of focusing damage on him. Do not go alone to defend a side lane while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available; trade for an objective or stop him with multiple players. In teamfights, maintain area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle, and block the enemy damage dealer's path.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a mobility tool, and critical strikes among many minions reduce its cooldown, making him hard to chase. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot die, so stun him with Udyr E Blazing Stampede or create distance and wait it out instead of dealing more damage. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.

Urgot.build: Urgot's main damage is physical, so build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early. Armor also helps Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield hold up. Urgot has high armor, so consider penetration when adding attack damage.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him with your first basic attack. Switch straight to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle. Decide before the fight which stance to use for Awakened.
Urgot.escape: Right after baiting out Urgot E Disdain, you can go in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to escape after being hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you can tell when Urgot's crowd control is coming, use Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get through the interrupting effect.
Urgot.fight: The moment Urgot E Disdain is down is your chance to close the distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Once you are on him, deal damage with two empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage lands. Do not stay near Urgot long enough to take repeated leg cannon damage.
Urgot.laning: Urgot is a difficult opponent for melee champions to beat in a direct lane fight, so farm or take him down with your jungler instead of forcing a fight. If ganking as Udyr, approach from a brush or behind terrain when Urgot has pushed the lane, or follow up on an ally's crowd control. Urgot E Disdain cannot cross walls, so standing by a wall can limit his engage angles.
Urgot.phase: Use this window while Urgot E Disdain is down to secure control. In the late game, Udyr shifts from dealing damage toward frontlining, so be careful about fighting near Urgot for too long.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand in front to keep the carry behind you from being pulled. Engage if Awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the crowd control stopping your engage; otherwise, stay beside your frontline and maintain area damage with Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Once you are on them, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy damage dealer's path.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, and the damage from his leg cannons builds up the longer you stay near him. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits, Urgot W Purge focuses its fire on you while you are heavily slowed, so decide immediately whether to get away with Udyr E Blazing Stampede as the charge comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before reaching the execution threshold.

Vi.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor first to counter Vi’s main damage. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield becomes more effective with armor, and Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only stack health.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun her with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks, then switch to Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure the fight. Use two empowered basic attacks in each stance, but avoid long fights where Vi W Denting Blows can stack up.
Vi.escape: Right after Vi uses Q Vault Breaker is your chance to engage with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to engage as Vi’s crowd control is about to land, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to use its brief crowd-control immunity.
Vi.fight: Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, deal damage after the shield has been removed. Trade briefly, then back off before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Vi.laning: Don’t approach while taking Vi Q Vault Breaker head-on. Start from a brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control. Get behind Vi when she pushes the lane. If she uses an ability on a minion to activate Vi P Blast Shield and approaches, wait until the shield is removed.
Vi.phase: In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so shift into a frontline role.
Vi.teamfight: While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, make sure your backline carries don’t go out of vision alone, and don’t try to stop Vi from moving while she is charging in. After she lands and the knock-up ends, stun her with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to peel for your team. If you can’t use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control stopping your engage, stay beside the frontline, keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm active, and endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it is charged, so move backward or to the side when you see her charging to dodge it. Vi W Denting Blows reduces a target’s armor and increases Vi’s attack speed as she hits the same target repeatedly, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target to the end, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash or stop Vi from moving while she is charging in.

Viego.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Armor also makes Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield more effective. If healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King can turn a prolonged duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling in after completing one core item.
Viego.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure the fight, using two empowered basic attacks. Time your engage so you can interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun when you see it.
Viego.escape: Even after Viego W Spectral Maw is down, Viego can escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so don’t chase immediately just because one mobility tool is down. Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede during a window when Viego R Heartbreaker hasn’t returned and Viego W Spectral Maw is down.
Viego.fight: If you can interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, engage and fight then. Back off without giving up a kill if you can’t win the skirmish.
Viego.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed and stance swapping to rotate between camps and ganks and take control of the jungle in the early and mid game. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control. Avoid walking straight at your target. If Viego E Harrowed Path makes black mist visible over terrain, avoid that route or use a Control Ward, and don’t push your lane in that direction.
Viego.phase: At this stage, consolidate your advantage through control of the enemy jungle and objectives. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on the frontline role.
Viego.teamfight: If an ally is killed in front of Viego, don’t continue fighting there. Lock Viego down with Udyr E Blazing Stampede to keep him from reaching the fallen ally’s wraith. If Viego possesses a champion, back off and endure until he returns to his original body, then counterattack. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control stopping your engage, go in. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline and use Udyr R Wingborne Storm to peel for your team.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so move to the side when you see him charging. If you’re close, interrupt the charge with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. If the stun is hard to avoid, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control. When health is low, watch out for Viego R Heartbreaker, as it deals damage based on missing health.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling in after completing one core item. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about choices that only stack health.
Volibear.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Then activate W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands and land two empowered basic attacks. If you need to engage through Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened at that moment.
Volibear.escape: Close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede after Volibear has used both Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer. Look especially for the window before Volibear R Stormbringer returns. If only Q Thundering Smash is down, account for his remaining mobility tool.
Volibear.fight: Engage right after Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off and deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks. Dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter to the side, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before an unavoidable heavy hit lands. Even if Volibear’s health has decreased, if you can’t finish him, don’t prolong the fight while allowing him to heal with W Frenzied Maul; back off and let cooldown time pass.
Volibear.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed and stance swapping to rotate quickly between camps and lanes and take control in the early and mid game. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control. Get behind Volibear when he pushes the lane, but account for his ability to escape if Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are still available.
Volibear.phase: At this point, use the window after Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off to turn your advantage into objectives and gains in the enemy jungle. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus on the frontline role.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has fully stacked P The Relentless Storm, don’t take the fight; engage after the stacks fall off. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control stopping your engage, go in. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline and keep R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active. Once close, endure with W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s empowered basic attack stuns, so stay outside its attack range until the time passes, or use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to absorb it when you need to get close. Move to the side when you see Volibear E Sky Splitter’s marker to avoid its damage and slow. Don’t fight Volibear right away if he is stacking Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions or monsters.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress, and also get armor against his basic attacks. If his healing is enough to turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling in after completing one core item.
Warwick.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Warwick’s counterattack damage lands to shield yourself and endure it.
Warwick.escape: Look for an engage before Warwick R Infinite Duress returns, and check whether Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is also down. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl is gone, close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to engage as the fear is about to trigger, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control.
Warwick.fight: Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active. After the fear is gone, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him. Follow with two empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Warwick.laning: In the early game, use Udyr’s fast movement between camps and ability to stay healthy to contest the enemy jungle and objectives. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control, rather than walking straight at your target. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so don’t overstay; recall.
Warwick.phase: Build your lead through objective and enemy jungle control through the mid game. In the late game, shift Udyr into a frontline role and protect your team.
Warwick.teamfight: Allow plenty of room for Warwick R Infinite Duress’s engage range, and watch the opposite side of the pit during objective standoffs. If Warwick uses R on an ally, focus on saving the ally he has locked down, and counterattack while Warwick is locked in place there. If it’s difficult for Udyr to go deep, stay beside the frontline, keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active, and endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, the damage he takes is reduced and it triggers a fear, so don’t use your burst. Back off and re-engage after the fear is gone. If you’re hit by Warwick R Infinite Duress, you’ll be suppressed and able to act, so watch for his engage from long range and out of vision when his movement speed is increased.

XinZhao.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor first since Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical. Armor also makes Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield more effective. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item.
XinZhao.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before Xin Zhao’s heavy damage lands, then follow with two empowered basic attacks. Decide which stance to use Awakened before the fight and use it accordingly.
XinZhao.escape: Your chance to engage is right after dodging the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning or baiting out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit is coming, use Udyr E Blazing Stampede to get out of range, or time Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened’s crowd-control immunity to meet it.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, then close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t force the fight; counterattack after its immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed to rotate between camps and ganks and take control of the jungle early. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control. When chasing Xin Zhao, herd him into a position where there is no target behind him for Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to escape to.
XinZhao.phase: At this stage, consolidate your advantage through control of the enemy jungle and objectives. In the late game, take the frontline role instead of chasing carries, and look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: If you expect Xin Zhao to engage, keep space between yourself and your allies so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split your formation all at once. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control stopping your engage, go in. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline and keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active. Once close, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle and counterattack when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.watch: Move to the side to dodge the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered basic attacks, get out of range with Udyr E Blazing Stampede before the third hit knocks you up.

Yasuo.build: Rush Plated Steelcaps and build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Armor also makes Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield improve your effective survivability.
Yasuo.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure the damage. Get two empowered basic attacks each time you change stances to make use of the stance effects and Awakened cooldown reduction.
Yasuo.escape: Your chance to engage is right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado misses. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again after a short time, so don’t chase just because he used it once. Engage from an angle where you can land Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun before Yasuo R Last Breath returns.
Yasuo.fight: Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado misses, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him, then deal damage with Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands to endure it.
Yasuo.laning: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light damage, then trade seriously after its brief duration ends. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as a path, so keeping the wave pushed slightly toward your side can limit his approach. If you gank, start from a brush or behind terrain, or go in when an ally applies crowd control, rather than walking straight at your target.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, Udyr’s limited range and area damage make the frontline role more important.
Yasuo.teamfight: If you’ve read the timing of crowd control that stops your engage, such as the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, break through with Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened. If you don’t have that opening, stay beside the frontline, keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active, and fend off incoming enemies. Once close, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle and block the enemy carries’ path.
Yasuo.watch: If Yasuo hits Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks you up, so watch the stacks and move to the side of its line. If you’re knocked up, Yasuo can follow with R Last Breath, so don’t rush your engage when the tornado is ready.

Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the telegraphed area of Yone W Spirit Cleave. Yone deals mixed damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Both resistances also make Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield more effective.
Yone.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to block damage and heal.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Yone has only used Q Mortal Steel. Check Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed too, and close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back off cooldown. If Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, engage after its stacks disappear.
Yone.fight: After dodging Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun him, then deal damage with two empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. Activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before a large hit lands.
Yone.laning: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, assume his tornado is ready and keep your distance. If you’re looking for a gank, approach from a brush or behind terrain instead of walking straight at him, or get behind him when he pushes the lane.
Yone.phase: In the early and mid game, consolidate your gains through jungle pressure and objective control. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on the frontline role.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and don’t stand alone at the very back of a formation within reach of Yone R Fate Sealed. If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through Yone’s crowd control that stops your engage, go in. Otherwise, stay beside the frontline and keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active. Once close, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly hits minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel, he is preparing his tornado, so wait outside its dash range until the stacks disappear. When he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, watch for the extra damage on his return, and don’t stand bunched up along the path of Yone R Fate Sealed.

Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and Mist Walker attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item.
Yorick.combo: Close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun with your first basic attack, then switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered basic attacks. Follow with Udyr W Iron Mantle to endure the fight, using two empowered basic attacks in each stance before switching to the next.
Yorick.escape: If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, it’s difficult for him to close in, so narrow the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. When Yorick W Dark Procession stops your engage, time Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control.
Yorick.fight: Approach after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses. When Yorick casts E Mourning Mist again, absorb the damage with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Yorick.laning: Don’t start a fight where many graves have accumulated near Yorick. Push the lane so enemies don’t die near him, and step forward to farm during the opening after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Yorick.phase: In the late game, Udyr shifts toward a frontline role, so use your fast movement to answer Yorick’s side lane pressure, then join your team.
Yorick.teamfight: If you can use Udyr E Blazing Stampede Awakened to get through the crowd control stopping your engage, go in. If you don’t have that opening, stay beside the frontline and keep Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow active. Once close, endure with Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist leaves a slow and mark and deals damage based on maximum health, so dodge the orb’s trajectory. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, you can hit the wall to break it. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.

Zac.build: Build magic resistance to withstand the damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot. If Zac P Cell Division’s healing can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item. During fights, step on the blobs Zac drops to prevent him from healing.
Zac.combo: Approach with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and stun Zac with your first basic attack. Immediately switch to Udyr Q Wilding Claw and land two empowered attacks, then hold out with Udyr W Iron Mantle. If Zac is already charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot and is within reach, interrupt it with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun.
Zac.escape: The moment Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is your chance to close the gap with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If you need to push through Zac’s knockup to get in, Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede as the effect hits.
Zac.fight: Immediately after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, stun him, and deal percent-health damage with empowered attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Fight while stepping on Zac’s blobs, and activate Udyr W Iron Mantle just before heavy damage hits. If you need to stay alive longer, Awaken Udyr W Iron Mantle to heal.
Zac.laning: Use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s movement speed to alternate between camps and lane ganks and take control in the early and mid game. Start ganks from a brush or behind terrain, or go in after an ally applies crowd control. Avoid walking straight at Zac for a gank while Zac E Elastic Slingshot is available.
Zac.phase: If Zac P Cell Division’s revive is down, treat it as an opportunity to look for your next fight. In the late game, Udyr lacks range and area damage, so focus more on playing the frontline.
Zac.teamfight: Watch for Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s approach angle, and use Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun to interrupt the charge if you can. Go in when Awaken Udyr E Blazing Stampede can get you through the enemy’s crowd control that stops engages. Otherwise, stay beside your frontline, keep up area damage and slows with Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and hold out with Udyr W Iron Mantle as you fend off Zac when he dives in.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing and knocking you up. If you see him charging behind a wall, avoid the landing spot. If you’re nearby, interrupt the charge with Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun. Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up, leaving you vulnerable to Zac W Unstable Matter’s max-health-based damage, so don’t start a fight somewhere you can’t check his approach angle.
